<!-- ARCHICELL Index v3.14 · PC 입출고 창 글씨·간격 키움(폰은 그대로) · Code는 v3.13 그대로 사용 -->
<!-- 이전: ARCHICELL Index v3.13 · 길이구분(원장·컷팅·잔재) 표시·선택 · 재고 카드 길이 칸 세로형(길이 위·수량 아래) · 색상 그룹 제목 간단히 (Code v3.13 필요) / v3.12 · 전문 확인 창(입고·출고·절단·취소) · 작업일 선택(과거 작업 등록) · 기록 기간 조회(최근 100건 제한 해제, Code v3.12 필요) · 기록 메모·작업일 수정 · 기준 미설정 표시 · 최근 메모 추천 / v3.11 · 입고·출고 저장 전 확인 문구 · QR 열기 속도(무거운 목록은 입출고 창 다음에 그림, 폰 배경 흐림 끔, 사진 640) / v3.10 · 관리 화면 가로 배치(품목 등록·수정 위/실사·조정 접기) · 품목명 규칙(종류에 크기 숫자가 있으면 중복 삭제, 실버는 생략) · 크기 자동 (30x30) · QR 라벨(M코드 맨 위, 찍으면 입고·출고 삭제) · 기록 메모 수정 / Code v3.10과 함께 적용 / v3.9.10 · 현황 목록 정렬(프로파일 먼저, 색상별 실버→블랙, 크기 작은 순 2020→2040→3030→3060→6060)과 색상 구분 제목 / v3.9.9 · 현황 오른쪽 패널 정리(오늘 요약 한 줄·보충 필요 위로·최근 입출고에서 취소/기초재고 숨김, 글씨 키움) / v3.9.8 · 입출고 기록: 날짜·시간 두 줄, 취소/기초재고 기본 숨김(스위치), 기간 버튼, 내 기록만, 더 보기, 엑셀(CSV) 내려받기 / v3.9.7 · 입출고 기록 화면 개선(품목명 중심·검색 확장·휴대폰 카드·건수 요약) · PC 로고 중복 수정 / v3.9.6 · 휴대폰 가운데 자재관리 표시 삭제 / v3.9.5 · 휴대폰 가운데 글자를 로고 글꼴(로고에서 잘라낸 ArchiCell)로 / v3.9.4 · 휴대폰 헤더는 로고 심볼만 / v3.9.3 · 휴대폰 메뉴를 ☰ 아래 작은 메뉴로 / v3.9.2 · 휴대폰 헤더(왼쪽 로고·가운데 ARCHICELL·오른쪽 메뉴) · PC 자재관리 통합시스템 / v3.9.1 글씨·굵기 완화 / v3.9 · 회사 로고 헤더 · 여백/요약/목록 정리 · 품목 사진 간편 등록(선택·Ctrl+V·드래그) / Code v3.9와 함께 적용 -->
<!-- 이전: ARCHICELL Index v3.8 · UI 개선 / Code v3.8과 함께 적용 · 이전: v3.7 : 큰 사진 · 사진 보기/바꾸기(붙여넣기·끌어놓기) · 현황에서 정보 수정 · 알루미늄 회색/블랙 색상 (Code v3.6 필요) -->
<html lang="ko"><head><base target="_top"><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1"><title>ARCHICELL 자재관리</title>
<!-- v3.8 간편 설정: 회사명·포인트 색·목록 사진 크기는 아래 세 값만 수정하세요. -->
<script>
const APP_UI = Object.freeze({brand:'ARCHICELL',accent:'#355fef',photoSize:88,motion:true});
document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--accent',APP_UI.accent);
document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--ph',APP_UI.photoSize+'px');
if(!APP_UI.motion)document.documentElement.dataset.motion='off';
</script>
<style>
:root{--ink:#203832;--green:#206851;--green-bg:#eff6f1;--green-line:#cfe3d6;--orange:#a8693a;--orange-bg:#fcf4eb;--orange-line:#ecd6bf;--paper:#f4f3ee;--muted:#758078;--line:#e0e4dc;--red:#a54530}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
body{margin:0;background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);font:16px/1.55 Pretendard,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI','Malgun Gothic',sans-serif;letter-spacing:-.02em;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
header{background:#19332e;color:#fff;padding:18px 18px;border-bottom:3px solid #a8bd94}
header>div,main{max-width:760px;margin:auto}
header b{font-size:21px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.12em;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px}
.brand-dot{display:inline-block;width:7px;height:7px;background:#b9cf9e;border-radius:50%}
header small{display:block;margin-top:3px;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.1em;color:#aebfb4}
#identity{font-size:11px;padding:5px 10px;border:1px solid #4a6457;border-radius:6px;color:#e4ece2}
main{padding:14px 12px 60px}
.row{display:flex;gap:9px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap}.spread{justify-content:space-between}
small,.muted{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted)}
button,input,select,textarea{font:inherit;color:inherit}
button{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;background:#fff;min-height:48px;padding:10px 16px;cursor:pointer;transition:filter .15s,transform .1s}
button:enabled:active{transform:translateY(1px);filter:brightness(.95)}
button:disabled{opacity:.35;cursor:default}
nav{display:flex;gap:4px;padding:4px;background:#e9ece4;border:1px solid #dce1d6;border-radius:12px;margin-bottom:10px}
nav button{flex:1;border:0;background:transparent;border-radius:8px;font-weight:650;color:#657164;font-size:14px;padding:8px 4px;min-height:42px;white-space:nowrap}
nav button.active{background:#fff;color:#193b2c;box-shadow:0 2px 5px #203a2612}
.status{margin:6px 2px 12px;font-size:11px;color:#7e887d}
.status button{min-height:30px;padding:2px 10px;font-size:12px;border-radius:7px;background:transparent}
.card{background:#fff;border:1px solid #dde2d7;border-radius:16px;padding:20px 18px;margin-bottom:14px;box-shadow:0 4px 18px #24331e05}
h1{font-size:23px;line-height:1.3;margin:0;font-weight:760;letter-spacing:-.04em}
h2{font-size:17px;margin:0 0 10px;font-weight:720}
p{margin:6px 0 12px}
label{display:block;margin:12px 0 5px;font-size:14px;font-weight:650}
input,select,textarea{width:100%;min-height:50px;background:#fff;padding:11px;border:1px solid #d2dbcd;border-radius:9px}
input::placeholder{color:#a5ada0}
input[type=checkbox]{width:20px;min-height:20px}
fieldset{border:0;padding:0;margin:0;min-width:0}
.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px}
.hidden{display:none!important}
.message{padding:13px 14px;border-radius:11px;background:#edf5e9;border:1px solid #d7e6cd;white-space:pre-line;margin:0 0 12px;font-size:14px;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.message.error{background:#fff0e9;border-color:#f0d1c0;color:#8a3220}
.low{color:var(--red);font-weight:750}
.primary{width:100%;font-weight:750;font-size:18px;margin-top:16px;min-height:56px;background:var(--green);color:#fff;border-color:var(--green)}
.ghost{min-height:34px;padding:4px 12px;font-size:13px;background:#f6f7f2;border-color:#e2e6dc;border-radius:8px}

/* 작업 화면 */
body:not(.has-item) .need-item{display:none!important}
body.has-item .no-item{display:none!important}
.result{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;padding:14px 16px;border-radius:14px;margin-bottom:12px;color:#fff;animation:pop .25s ease-out}
.result b{display:block;font-size:20px;line-height:1.3}
.result span{display:block;font-size:13px;opacity:.9}
.result.out{background:var(--orange)}.result.in{background:var(--green)}.result.cancel{background:#5d6b66}.result.saving{background:#dfe5dc;color:var(--ink)}
.result button{flex-shrink:0;min-height:44px;padding:6px 14px;font-size:14px;font-weight:700;background:#ffffff26;border:1px solid #ffffff66;color:#fff}
.result button.armed{background:#fff;color:var(--red);border-color:#fff}
@keyframes pop{from{transform:scale(.97);opacity:.4}to{transform:none;opacity:1}}
.item-card{padding:18px}
.item-card.is-low{border-color:#efc9b8}
.item-top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-bottom:8px}
.code-chip{font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.04em;padding:3px 9px;border-radius:6px;background:#eef2ea;color:#4f6457}
#selected-detail{margin:4px 0 0}
.stock-line{display:flex;align-items:baseline;justify-content:space-between;margin-top:12px;padding-top:12px;border-top:1px solid #eef0ea}
.stock-line strong{font-size:46px;line-height:1.05;font-weight:780;letter-spacing:-.05em}
.stock-line strong small{font-size:18px;font-weight:600;margin-left:4px;color:var(--ink)}
#selected-low{font-size:13px;margin-top:4px}
.lane{border-radius:14px;padding:14px;margin-bottom:12px;background:var(--green-bg);border:1px solid var(--green-line);border-left:4px solid var(--green)}
.lane.outbound{background:var(--orange-bg);border-color:var(--orange-line);border-left-color:var(--orange)}
.lane.focus{box-shadow:0 0 0 3px #20685133}.lane.outbound.focus{box-shadow:0 0 0 3px #a8693a33}
.lane-head{display:flex;align-items:baseline;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;margin-bottom:10px}
.lane-head h2{margin:0;font-size:20px;color:var(--green)}.outbound .lane-head h2{color:var(--orange)}
.lane-head span{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)}
.qty{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:8px}
.qty button{min-height:64px;padding:6px 2px;font-size:24px;font-weight:780;background:var(--green);border-color:var(--green);color:#fff;border-radius:11px}
.qty button small{font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:inherit;margin-left:1px}
.outbound .qty button{background:var(--orange);border-color:var(--orange)}
.direct{width:100%;margin-top:8px;min-height:42px;font-size:14px;background:transparent;border-color:var(--green-line);color:#456654}
.outbound .direct{border-color:var(--orange-line);color:#8d6644}
.custom-panel{border:2px solid var(--green-line)}
.custom-panel.outbound{border-color:var(--orange-line)}
.custom-panel.outbound #custom-save{background:var(--orange);border-color:var(--orange)}
.scanrow{display:flex;gap:8px}.scanrow input{flex:1;min-width:0}.scanrow button{flex-shrink:0}
.find-list{margin-top:8px}
.listitem{width:100%;text-align:left;margin:6px 0 0;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:12px;border-radius:10px;border-color:#e2e7dc;background:#fcfdf9}
.listitem small{display:block}
.listitem.current{border-color:var(--green);background:var(--green-bg)}
.hint{display:flex;gap:14px;align-items:center;padding:16px;border-radius:12px;background:var(--green-bg);border:1px dashed var(--green-line);margin-bottom:14px}
.hint .icon{font-size:30px;line-height:1}
.hint b{display:block;font-size:17px}

/* 재고·기록·관리 */
.overview{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:14px 0}.overview span{padding:7px 11px;border-radius:9px;background:#f3f6ef;font-size:12px}
.tablewrap{overflow-x:auto}
table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:13px;min-width:600px}
th,td{text-align:left;padding:11px 9px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);vertical-align:top}
th{background:#f2f5f1;white-space:nowrap}
td button{font-size:13px;min-height:36px;padding:5px 10px}
details{margin-top:10px}summary{cursor:pointer;font-size:14px}
.check{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.pill{display:inline-block;background:#f7e6cf;color:#7a4b16;border-radius:8px;padding:4px 10px;font-size:13px}
button:focus-visible,input:focus,select:focus{outline:3px solid #85cbb6;outline-offset:2px}

/* QR 라벨 */
.labels{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px;margin-top:18px}
.qrlabel{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;border:1px solid #d1dcc9;border-radius:10px;padding:14px;break-inside:avoid;background:#fff}
.qrsvg{width:130px;flex-shrink:0}.qrsvg svg{width:100%;display:block;shape-rendering:crispEdges}
.qrm{overflow-wrap:anywhere;min-width:0}.qrm b{display:block;font-size:22px;line-height:1.2}
.qr-operation{display:inline-block;padding:3px 8px;border-radius:6px;background:#e1f3e8;color:#12624c;font-size:13px;margin-bottom:6px}

@media(max-width:600px){.grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.labels{grid-template-columns:1fr}.qty button{font-size:22px;min-height:60px}.stock-line strong{font-size:42px}}
@media print{body{background:#fff}header,nav,.noprint,.status,main>section:not(#view-labels),#global,#pending-box{display:none!important}main,#view-labels{display:block!important;padding:0;max-width:none}.card{border:0;padding:0;box-shadow:none}.labels{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:5mm}.qrlabel{min-height:48mm;padding:3mm;border-radius:0;border-color:#333}.qrsvg{width:34mm}@page{size:A4;margin:10mm}}

/* v2.5 — overview first, one operation at a time */
.dashboard-metrics{grid-template-columns:1.4fr 1fr 1fr 1fr}.total-metric{background:#1f5141;color:white;border-color:#1f5141}.total-metric>strong{font-size:31px}.total-metric .metric-note{color:#c0d1c4}.movement-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.operation-choice>h2{font-size:21px;margin:7px 0}.operation-choice>p{margin-bottom:18px}.operation-options{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px}.operation-option{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;text-align:left;min-height:160px;padding:22px;border-radius:12px}.operation-option>span{font-size:28px;line-height:1}.operation-option>b{font-size:25px;margin:12px 0 5px}.operation-option>small{font-size:12px}.out-option{background:#fcf4eb;color:#a8693a;border-color:#e8d3bb}.in-option{background:#eff6f1;color:#206851;border-color:#cfe3d6}.operation-toolbar{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;margin:0 0 14px}.operation-toolbar>b{font-size:16px}.operation-toolbar button{font-size:11px}.movement-grid .lane{padding:20px}.movement-grid .qty{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr)}.movement-grid .qty button{min-height:76px;font-size:28px}.movement-grid .direct{margin-top:10px;min-height:42px}.work-rule{margin-top:16px}

/* v2.6 추가: 분류별 수량 요약/표시 */
.dashboard-metrics{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))}.category-badge{display:inline-block;font-size:10px;padding:2px 7px;border-radius:5px;background:#eaf0e9;color:#52705a;margin:4px 0}.metric>strong{font-size:26px;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.listitem .category-badge{font-size:9px}#item-unit{max-width:100%}@media(max-width:760px){.dashboard-metrics{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))}.metric{padding:10px 8px}.metric>strong{font-size:20px}.metric>span:first-child{font-size:11px}}

/* v3.0 길이별 재고 카드 · 길이 선택 · 절단 */
.scard{display:flex;gap:14px;align-items:flex-start;width:100%;text-align:left;margin:8px 0 0;padding:14px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;background:#fff;min-height:0;cursor:pointer}
.scard.is-low{border-color:#efc9b8}
.sc-photo{position:relative;flex:0 0 76px;width:76px;height:76px;border-radius:10px;background:#f1f4f1;border:1px solid #e4e9e4;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:#a9b6ad;overflow:hidden}
.sc-photo img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;background:#fff}
.sc-body{flex:1;min-width:0;display:block}
.sc-m,.order-chip{display:block;font-size:11px;color:#8a978f;letter-spacing:.04em;margin-bottom:2px}
.kv{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:8px;font-size:13px;line-height:1.6;min-width:0}
.kv em{flex:0 0 44px;font-style:normal;font-size:11px;color:#8a978f}
.kv b,.kv h1{font-size:15px;font-weight:720;margin:0;overflow-wrap:anywhere;letter-spacing:-.03em}
.kv .category-badge{margin:0 0 0 2px}
.lc-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(92px,1fr));gap:6px;margin-top:10px}
.lc{display:block;padding:6px 10px;border:1px solid #e1e7e2;border-radius:8px;background:#fafbf8}
.lc small{display:block;font-size:11px;color:#6f8177}
.lc b{display:block;font-size:19px;font-weight:760;letter-spacing:-.03em;line-height:1.25}
.lc b i{font-style:normal;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;margin-left:2px;color:#6f8177}
.lc.low{background:#fff4ec;border-color:#efcdb4}.lc.low small,.lc.low b,.lc.low b i{color:#a5532d}
.lc.zero b{color:#a5aea7}
.lc.more{display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;align-items:center;font-weight:700;color:#3f6f58;background:#f1f6f1;border-style:dashed;cursor:pointer}
.sc-foot{display:block;font-size:11px;color:#8a978f;margin-top:8px}
.item-top .order-chip{display:inline;margin:0 8px 0 0}
.sel-head{display:flex;gap:14px;align-items:flex-start}.sel-info{flex:1;min-width:0}.sel-info .kv h1{font-size:19px}
#selected-lens{margin-top:12px}
.len-panel{margin:0 0 12px;padding:14px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:11px;background:#fff}
.len-panel>b{display:block;font-size:15px;margin-bottom:10px}
.len-chips{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(110px,1fr));gap:8px}
.len-chip{min-height:58px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:center;padding:8px 12px;border-radius:9px;text-align:left}
.len-chip b{font-size:17px}.len-chip small{font-size:11px;color:#7c8c82}
.len-chip.on{background:#246a55;border-color:#246a55;color:#fff}.len-chip.on small{color:#d7e8de}
.len-new{display:flex;gap:8px;margin-top:10px}.len-new input{flex:1;min-width:0}.len-new button{flex-shrink:0;min-height:44px;font-size:13px}
.operation-options .cut-option{grid-column:1/-1;min-height:62px;flex-direction:row;align-items:center;gap:12px;background:#f2f4f7;color:#3e5470;border-color:#d6dde6;padding:12px 22px}
.operation-options .cut-option>b{margin:0;font-size:20px}.operation-options .cut-option>span{font-size:22px}
.cut-panel{margin:16px 0 0;padding:18px;border:2px solid #d6dde6}
.cut-row{display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center;margin-top:6px}.cut-row input{flex:1;min-width:0}.cut-row span{font-size:12px;color:#6f8177;white-space:nowrap}.cut-row button{min-height:40px;padding:4px 12px}
.cut-panel #cut-save{background:#3e5470;border-color:#3e5470;color:#fff}
.result.cut{background:#4a5f78}
@media(max-width:760px){.sc-photo{flex-basis:60px;width:60px;height:60px}.lc-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(84px,1fr))}.lc b{font-size:17px}.kv em{flex-basis:40px}.operation-options .cut-option{min-height:56px;padding:10px 18px}}

/* ===== v3.1 현황판 · 빠른 입출고 창 · 차분한 색 ===== */
:root{--ink:#1d2120;--green:#2b3330;--paper:#f5f4f0;--muted:#8b8f8a;--line:#e5e3dd}
header{background:#1d2120!important;border-bottom:0!important}.brand-dot{background:#c9c6bd!important}
nav{background:#ebe9e3!important}nav button.active{color:#1d2120!important}
.page-intro,#dashboard-metrics{display:none!important}
#ac-qr{background:#fff!important;color:#1d2120!important;border-color:#fff!important}
#ac-sheet{background:#2e3532!important;color:#fff!important;border-color:#ffffff33!important}
.dash{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 340px;gap:18px;align-items:start}
.dash-tools{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.chips{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.chip{min-height:36px;padding:4px 15px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:#fff;font-size:13px;color:#4c524f}
.chip b{margin-left:5px}.chip.on{background:#1d2120;border-color:#1d2120;color:#fff}
.chip.warn{color:#b4532a}.chip.warn.on{background:#b4532a;border-color:#b4532a;color:#fff}
.dash-tools input{max-width:320px;min-height:38px;margin:0}
.rows-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}
.srow{display:grid;grid-template-columns:64px minmax(180px,260px) minmax(0,1fr) 96px;gap:16px;align-items:center;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:10px 16px;cursor:pointer;transition:border-color .15s}
.srow:hover{border-color:#cfccc3}
.srow .sc-photo{width:64px;height:64px;flex:0 0 64px;border-radius:10px;align-self:center}.qs-head .sc-photo{width:56px;height:56px;flex:0 0 56px;border-radius:10px}
.srow-info{min-width:0}.srow-info small{display:block;font-size:11px;color:var(--muted)}
.srow-info b{display:block;font-size:15px;font-weight:720;line-height:1.35;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.lowtag{display:inline-block;margin-left:6px;font-size:10px;padding:1px 6px;border-radius:5px;background:#fbefe8;color:#b4532a;font-weight:700;vertical-align:2px}
.srow-lens{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px}
.lchip{min-height:40px;padding:5px 12px;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:#faf9f6;font-size:12px;color:#5d635f;display:inline-flex;align-items:baseline;gap:8px}
.lchip b{font-size:17px;color:#1d2120;font-weight:760}.lchip:hover{border-color:#1d2120}
.lchip.low{background:#fbefe8;border-color:#f0d3c2;color:#b4532a}.lchip.low b{color:#b4532a}
.lchip.zero b{color:#b9bcb7}
.srow-total{text-align:right;white-space:nowrap}.srow-total small{display:block;font-size:10px;color:var(--muted)}.srow-total b{font-size:22px;font-weight:780;letter-spacing:-.04em}.srow-total b i{font-style:normal;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--muted);margin-left:3px}
.srow-m{display:block;font-size:12px!important;font-weight:700;color:#3d4440!important;letter-spacing:.02em;margin-bottom:2px}.srow-m .lowtag{margin-left:6px}
.kv2{display:flex;gap:8px;font-size:12px;line-height:1.6;min-width:0}.kv2 em{flex:0 0 38px;white-space:nowrap;font-style:normal;color:var(--muted)}.kv2 span{min-width:0;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.form-sec{margin:22px 0 2px;font-size:12px;font-weight:750;color:#1d2120;padding-bottom:6px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.ac-toast{position:fixed;left:50%;top:calc(env(safe-area-inset-top,0px) + 18px);transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:10000;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;max-width:calc(100% - 32px);padding:13px 20px;border-radius:14px;background:#1d2120;color:#fff;font-size:15px;font-weight:700;box-shadow:0 10px 30px #0004;animation:tIn .18s ease-out}
.ac-toast.ok{background:#245a46}.ac-toast.err{background:#a3462a}
.ac-toast .t-ico{width:20px;height:20px;flex-shrink:0;border-radius:50%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:13px}
.ac-toast.ok .t-ico::before{content:'✓'}.ac-toast.err .t-ico::before{content:'!'}
.ac-toast.busy .t-ico{border:2.5px solid #ffffff44;border-top-color:#fff;animation:tSpin .8s linear infinite}
@keyframes tIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translate(-50%,-8px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,0)}}@keyframes tSpin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
.kv2.nm span{font-size:14px;font-weight:720;color:#1d2120}
.dash-side{position:sticky;top:12px;padding:18px}
.dash-side h2{font-size:14px;margin:0}
.today{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px;margin:10px 0 18px}
.today div{background:#f5f4f0;border-radius:10px;padding:10px 12px}.today small{display:block;font-size:11px;color:var(--muted)}.today b{font-size:22px;letter-spacing:-.04em}
.side-sec{margin-top:18px}.side-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:4px}
.act{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:9px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #efede8;font-size:12px}.act:last-child{border-bottom:0}
.act-type{flex-shrink:0;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;padding:3px 7px;border-radius:5px;background:#efede8;color:#5d635f;min-width:42px;text-align:center}
.act-type.t-out{background:#1d2120;color:#fff}.act-type.t-in{background:#fff;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px #1d2120;color:#1d2120}
.act-main{flex:1;min-width:0}.act-main b{display:block;font-size:12px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.act-main small{display:block;font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.act strong{font-size:14px;white-space:nowrap}
.lowrow{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;width:100%;min-height:0;padding:8px 0;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid #efede8;border-radius:0;background:transparent;font-size:12px;text-align:left}
.lowrow b{color:#b4532a;white-space:nowrap}
.qs{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:9000;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.qs-dim{position:absolute;inset:0;background:#1d212066}
.qs-box{position:relative;width:min(460px,calc(100% - 32px));max-height:calc(100% - 40px);overflow:auto;background:#fff;border-radius:18px;padding:20px;box-shadow:0 20px 50px #0003}
.qs-head{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:18px}
.qs-title{flex:1;min-width:0}.qs-title small{display:block;font-size:11px;color:var(--muted)}.qs-title b{display:block;font-size:17px;line-height:1.3}
.qs-icon{min-height:38px;width:38px;padding:0;border-radius:10px;background:#f5f4f0;border-color:#f5f4f0;font-size:15px;flex-shrink:0}
.qs-label{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);margin:0 0 6px;font-weight:650}
.qs-lens{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;margin-bottom:16px}
.qchip{min-height:50px;padding:6px 14px;border-radius:11px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:center;font-weight:720;font-size:15px;line-height:1.25}
.qchip small{font-size:11px;font-weight:500;color:var(--muted)}
.qchip.on{background:#1d2120;border-color:#1d2120;color:#fff}.qchip.on small{color:#c9ccc8}
.qchip.add{border-style:dashed;color:#5d635f;font-weight:600;font-size:13px}
#qs-newlen{width:150px;min-height:50px;margin:0}
.qs-qty{display:grid;grid-template-columns:60px 1fr 60px;gap:8px;margin-bottom:8px}
.qs-qty button{min-height:62px;font-size:26px;padding:0;border-radius:12px;background:#f5f4f0;border-color:#f5f4f0}
.qs-qty input{min-height:62px;text-align:center;font-size:30px;font-weight:780;border-radius:12px;letter-spacing:-.03em;margin:0}
#qs-memo{min-height:42px;font-size:13px;margin:0}
.qs-hint{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);margin:10px 0 12px;min-height:18px}.qs-hint.bad{color:#b4532a}
.qs-actions{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px}
.qs-btn{min-height:58px;font-size:17px;font-weight:780;border-radius:12px}
.qs-btn.out{background:#1d2120;border-color:#1d2120;color:#fff}
.qs-btn.in{background:#fff;border:1.5px solid #1d2120;color:#1d2120}
.qs-result{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;margin-top:12px;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:11px;background:#eef3ef;font-size:12px;color:#24493a}
.qs-result button{min-height:34px;font-size:12px;padding:4px 10px;flex-shrink:0;background:#fff}
.qs-result button.armed{background:#b4532a;color:#fff;border-color:#b4532a}
body.qs-open{overflow:hidden}
#qs .cut-panel{margin:0;border:0;padding:0;box-shadow:none}#qs .cut-panel #cut-save{background:#1d2120;border-color:#1d2120}
@media(max-width:1100px){.dash{grid-template-columns:1fr}.dash-side{position:static}}
@media(max-width:760px){
 .srow{grid-template-columns:48px minmax(0,1fr) auto;gap:10px 12px;padding:12px}
 .srow .sc-photo{width:48px;height:48px;flex-basis:48px}
 .srow-lens{grid-row:2;grid-column:1/-1}.srow-total{grid-row:1;grid-column:3}.srow-total b{font-size:18px}
 .dash-tools input{max-width:none;flex:1 1 100%}
 .qs{align-items:flex-end}
 .qs-box{width:100%;max-height:92%;border-radius:20px 20px 0 0;padding:18px 16px calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px) + 18px)}
}

/* ===== v3.7 알루미늄 프로파일 톤 (그레이·블랙) — 색만 바꿉니다 ===== */
:root{--ink:#1b1e21;--green:#2a2f33;--green-bg:#f1f3f4;--green-line:#d5d9dd;--paper:#eceef0;--muted:#626b73;--line:#d9dde1;--red:#b4532a;--accent:#4b7a96;--soft:#f4f5f6;--ph:clamp(88px,26vw,112px)}
body{background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink)}
header{background:#1b1e21!important;border-bottom:3px solid #9aa2a8!important}
.brand-dot{background:#aab2b8!important}
header small{color:#aab2b8}
#identity{color:#e8ebed;border-color:#ffffff30}
nav{background:#dfe2e5!important}
nav button{color:#5f6870}
nav button.active{background:#fff;color:#1b1e21!important;box-shadow:0 1px 4px #1b1e2120}
#ac-sheet{background:#363b3f!important}
.status button{background:#fff;border-color:var(--line)}
.card{border-color:var(--line);box-shadow:0 2px 10px #1b1e2108}
.message{background:#eef1f3;border-color:#d9dde1}
.message.error{background:#fff0e9;border-color:#f0d1c0}
input,select,textarea{border-color:#cfd4d8}
button:focus-visible,input:focus,select:focus{outline:3px solid #9fc0d4;outline-offset:2px}
th{background:#eef0f2}
.chip{border-color:var(--line);color:#41484e}.chip.on{background:#1b1e21;border-color:#1b1e21}
.chip.warn{color:#b4532a}.chip.warn.on{background:#b4532a;border-color:#b4532a;color:#fff}
.srow{border-color:var(--line)}.srow:hover{border-color:#a6aeb4;box-shadow:0 2px 12px #1b1e2112}
.srow-m{color:#353b40!important}
.lchip{background:var(--soft);border-color:var(--line);color:#4a5258}.lchip:hover{border-color:#1b1e21}.lchip b{color:#1b1e21}
.lchip.low{background:#fbefe8;border-color:#f0d3c2;color:#b4532a}.lchip.low b{color:#b4532a}
.lchip.zero b{color:#b3b8bc}
.lc{background:var(--soft);border-color:var(--line)}.lc.more{background:#eef0f1;color:#4a5258}
.len-chip.on{background:#2a2f33;border-color:#2a2f33}
.category-badge{background:#e8ebed;color:#4a5258}
.code-chip{background:#eceef0;color:#4a5258}
.today div{background:var(--soft)}
.act{border-bottom-color:#e6e8ea}.lowrow{border-bottom-color:#e6e8ea}
.act-type{background:#eceef0;color:#4a5258}
.form-sec{color:#1b1e21;border-bottom-color:var(--line)}
.label-settings button{background:#2a2f33}
.label-settings .pill{background:#e8ebed;color:#4a5258}
.qr-operation{background:#e8ebed;color:#2a2f33}
.qrlabel{border-color:#cfd4d8}
.ac-toast.ok{background:#2f3a42}.ac-toast.err{background:#a3462a}
.qs-icon{background:#eceef0;border-color:#eceef0}
.qs-qty button{background:#eceef0;border-color:#eceef0}
.qs-result{background:#eceef0;color:#2a2f33}
.qs-btn.out{background:#1b1e21;border-color:#1b1e21}.qs-btn.in{border-color:#1b1e21;color:#1b1e21}
.qchip.on{background:#1b1e21;border-color:#1b1e21}
#company-enter{background:#2a2f33;color:#fff;border-color:#2a2f33;font-weight:750;min-height:50px}
.sc-photo{background:#e6e9eb;border-color:#d9dde1;color:#9aa3a9}
.sc-photo img{object-fit:contain;background:#fff}

/* ===== v3.7 큰 사진 (목록·입출고 창) ===== */
.srow{grid-template-columns:var(--ph) minmax(170px,250px) minmax(0,1fr) 96px}
.srow .sc-photo{width:var(--ph);height:var(--ph);flex:0 0 var(--ph);border-radius:12px;background:#fff;cursor:zoom-in}
.qs-head .sc-photo{width:84px;height:84px;flex:0 0 84px;border-radius:12px;background:#fff;cursor:zoom-in}
.qs-head .sc-photo.editable::after{content:'✎';position:absolute;right:4px;bottom:4px;width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:50%;background:#1b1e21;color:#fff;font-size:12px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;z-index:2}
.qs-title b{font-size:18px}

/* ===== v3.7 사진 보기·바꾸기 창 ===== */
.pv{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:9500;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.pv-dim{position:absolute;inset:0;background:#0b0d0ecc}
.pv-box{position:relative;width:min(720px,calc(100% - 24px));max-height:calc(100% - 24px);overflow:auto;background:#fff;border-radius:18px;padding:16px;box-shadow:0 20px 60px #0006}
.pv-head{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:12px}
.pv-stage{position:relative;background:#e6e9eb;border-radius:12px;height:min(62vh,520px);min-height:220px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;overflow:hidden}
.pv-stage img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain;background:transparent;display:block}
.ac-toast{width:max-content}
.pv-empty{position:absolute;color:#6f7981;font-size:14px;text-align:center;padding:0 20px}
.pv-tag{position:absolute;left:10px;top:10px;background:#1b1e21;color:#fff;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;padding:5px 10px;border-radius:8px}
.pv-stage.drag{outline:3px dashed var(--accent);outline-offset:-6px}
.pv-hint{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);margin:10px 0 12px;min-height:18px}
.pv-actions{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px}
.pv-actions button{min-height:52px;font-weight:700;font-size:15px;border-radius:12px}
.pv-primary{background:#1b1e21!important;border-color:#1b1e21!important;color:#fff!important}
.pv-danger{color:#a3462a}

/* ===== v3.7 현황에서 바로 정보 수정 ===== */
.qe-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px}
.qe-grid label,#qe-counts label{margin:0 0 4px;font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:650}
.qe-grid input,#qe-counts input{margin:0;min-height:46px}
#qs-edit .muted{font-size:12px;margin:8px 0 0}
#qs-edit details{margin:14px 0 4px;background:var(--soft);border-radius:12px;padding:10px 12px}
#qs-edit summary{font-size:13px;font-weight:650}
#qe-counts{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(110px,1fr));gap:8px;margin-top:10px}
#qs-edit .qs-actions{margin-top:14px}

@media(max-width:760px){
 .srow{grid-template-columns:var(--ph) minmax(0,1fr) auto;align-items:start}
 .srow .sc-photo{width:var(--ph);height:var(--ph);flex-basis:var(--ph)}
 .kv2{font-size:13px}.kv2 em{flex-basis:42px}.srow-m{font-size:13px!important}
 .lchip{min-height:44px;font-size:13px}.lchip b{font-size:18px}
 .srow-total b{font-size:20px}
 input,select,textarea{font-size:16px}
 .qs-head .sc-photo{width:84px;height:84px;flex-basis:84px}
 .qe-grid{gap:8px}
 .pv{align-items:flex-end}
 .pv-box{width:100%;max-height:96%;border-radius:20px 20px 0 0;padding:14px 14px calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px) + 14px)}
 .pv-stage{height:min(58vh,440px)}
}
</style></head><body>
<style>
body:not(.company-ready)>header,body:not(.company-ready)>main{display:none!important}
#company-login{max-width:430px;margin:10vh auto;padding:30px;background:white;border:1px solid #ddd;border-radius:18px}
#company-login h1{font-size:25px}#company-login input,#company-login select{width:100%;margin:6px 0 14px;padding:12px;box-sizing:border-box}
#company-login button{width:100%;padding:14px}#company-login label{display:block}
#login-error{white-space:pre-wrap;color:#b42318}#company-logout{font-size:12px;margin-left:10px;min-height:32px;padding:4px 12px;background:transparent!important;color:#fff!important;border:1px solid #ffffff73!important;border-radius:8px;font-weight:650;white-space:nowrap}#company-logout:active{background:#ffffff26!important}
@media(max-width:480px){#company-login{margin:30px 14px;padding:22px}}
</style>
<style id="archicell-ui">/* ===== v3.8 DESIGN SYSTEM: white / graphite / cobalt ===== */
:root{--ink:#20242c;--paper:#f5f6f8;--line:#e5e8ee;--muted:#707987;--soft:#f4f6fa;--ph:88px;--ui-radius:18px;--ui-ease:cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)}
body{background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);font-size:14px;overscroll-behavior-y:none;font-feature-settings:'tnum'}
button,input,select,textarea{font:inherit}button{touch-action:manipulation;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent;transition:background .16s,border-color .16s,box-shadow .16s,transform .16s}
button:not(:disabled):active{transform:scale(.975)}button:disabled{cursor:default;opacity:.48}button:focus-visible,[role=button]:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:3px}
input,select,textarea{border:1px solid #dce1e9;border-radius:11px;background:#fff;transition:border-color .16s,box-shadow .16s;color:var(--ink)}
input:focus,select:focus,textarea:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--accent);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 12%,transparent)}
header{background:#fff!important;color:var(--ink);padding:20px 32px!important;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)!important}header>div,main{max-width:1440px}
header b{font-size:22px;letter-spacing:.1em;color:#20242c}header small{color:#858c98;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.16em;margin-top:5px}.brand-dot{background:var(--accent)!important;width:6px;height:6px}
#identity{color:#4d586a;background:#f3f5f9;border:0;border-radius:8px;padding:8px 12px;font-weight:650}
#company-logout{color:#677181!important;border:1px solid var(--line)!important;background:#fff!important;min-height:36px;font-size:11px}
main{padding:24px 32px 56px}.app-toolbar{margin-bottom:32px;gap:18px}.app-toolbar nav{background:#fff!important;border:1px solid var(--line);min-width:0;border-radius:13px;padding:5px;display:flex;gap:4px;box-shadow:0 2px 4px #1b243003}
nav button{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:42px;border-radius:9px;padding:10px 21px;border:0;background:transparent;color:#777f8e;font-weight:650}nav button svg{width:18px;height:18px;flex-shrink:0}nav button.active{background:#eef2ff!important;color:var(--accent)!important;box-shadow:none}
.status{font-size:11px;color:#808896;gap:10px}.status button{min-height:35px;font-size:11px;border-radius:9px;padding:6px 11px}
.ui-heading{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin:0 0 24px}.ui-eyebrow{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.16em;color:#9299a6;font-weight:750}.ui-heading h1{font-size:30px;letter-spacing:-.055em;margin:6px 0;font-weight:780}.ui-heading p{margin:0;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px}.ui-version{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.08em;color:#9299a6;border:1px solid var(--line);padding:6px 10px;border-radius:6px}
.ui-overview{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1.25fr 1fr;gap:14px;margin:0 0 28px}.ui-overview>div,.ui-overview>button{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--ui-radius);padding:20px 23px;text-align:left;box-shadow:0 3px 8px #22324c03;min-height:130px}.ui-overview span{font-size:12px;color:#687385;font-weight:600}.ui-overview b{display:block;font-size:30px;letter-spacing:-.05em;margin:9px 0 3px;line-height:1.25;font-weight:760}.ui-overview small{font-size:12px;letter-spacing:0;font-weight:550;color:#9299a6;margin-left:7px}.ui-overview p{font-size:11px;color:#9299a6;margin:0}.ui-overview .ui-low{background:#f0f3ff;border-color:#e3e8ff}.ui-low b{color:var(--accent)}.ui-low i{display:inline-block;width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent);margin-right:6px}.ui-low p{display:flex;justify-content:space-between}
.dash{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 290px;gap:22px}.dash-tools{gap:12px;margin-bottom:16px;align-items:center}.chips{gap:5px}.chip{min-height:36px;border:0;background:transparent;padding:7px 13px;border-radius:9px;font-size:12px}.chip b{font-size:10px;opacity:.65;margin-left:5px}.chip.on{background:#222731;color:white}.chip.warn.on{background:#a95031;color:#fff}.dash-tools input{max-width:290px;min-height:42px;background:#fff;font-size:13px;padding:10px 14px}
.rows-list{gap:10px}.srow{border-radius:15px;padding:16px;gap:16px;grid-template-columns:var(--ph) minmax(140px,200px) minmax(0,1fr) 76px;box-shadow:0 2px 5px #1b243003;transition:border-color .18s,box-shadow .18s,background .18s}.srow:hover{border-color:#bac5db;box-shadow:0 4px 18px #293e7010}.srow .sc-photo{border:1px solid #e9ecf2;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#fafbfc,#f0f2f6);border-radius:12px;color:#a4adba}.sc-photo img{mix-blend-mode:multiply}.srow-m{font-size:10px!important;letter-spacing:.07em;color:#66758c!important;margin-bottom:7px}.kv2{font-size:11px;gap:5px}.kv2 em{font-size:10px;color:#9aa1ad}.kv2.nm span{font-size:14px;font-weight:700;color:#2b3039}.srow-total small{color:#9aa1ad;font-size:9px;margin-bottom:3px}.srow-total b{font-size:24px;color:#252c38}.srow-total b i{font-size:10px}.lchip{border:1px solid #e7ebf2;background:#f7f9fc;border-radius:8px;font-size:10px;padding:5px 9px;min-height:34px;gap:7px}.lchip b{font-size:15px}.lchip.low{background:#fff6ee;border-color:#f5e2cf}.lowtag{border-radius:4px;font-size:9px}
.dash-side{top:20px;padding:20px;border-radius:var(--ui-radius);box-shadow:none;background:#fff;border-color:var(--line)}.dash-side h2{font-size:13px;font-weight:750}.today{margin:14px 0 22px}.today div{padding:13px;border:1px solid #eef0f5;background:#f8f9fc;border-radius:11px}.today b{font-size:25px}.today small{font-size:10px}.side-head .muted{font-size:10px}.side-sec{margin-top:22px}.act{padding:12px 0;gap:8px}.act-type{font-size:9px;min-width:35px;padding:4px 6px}.act-main b{font-size:11px}.act-main small{font-size:9px}.act strong{font-size:13px}.lowrow{padding:11px 0;font-size:11px}
.qs{justify-content:flex-end;align-items:stretch}.qs-dim{background:#18223655;backdrop-filter:blur(3px);animation:uiDim .24s ease}.qs-box{width:min(510px,100%);max-height:100%;height:100%;border-radius:24px 0 0 24px;padding:28px;box-shadow:-12px 0 60px #12203b17;overscroll-behavior:contain;scrollbar-width:thin;animation:uiDrawer .32s var(--ui-ease);scrollbar-gutter:stable}
.ui-grab{display:none}.ui-panel-kicker{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;font-size:9px;color:#97a0af;letter-spacing:.13em;margin:0 0 26px}.ui-panel-kicker span{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:0;color:#7a8495}.qs-head{gap:10px;margin-bottom:22px}.qs-head .sc-photo{width:68px;height:68px;flex-basis:68px;border-color:var(--line);background:#f5f7fb}.qs-title b{font-size:19px;letter-spacing:-.04em;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.qs-title small{font-size:10px;margin-bottom:6px;color:#939cab}.qs-icon{border:0;background:#f1f3f7;min-height:34px;width:34px;border-radius:9px;color:#687385;font-size:14px;flex-shrink:0}.ui-balance{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;background:#f5f7fc;border:1px solid #e9edf5;border-radius:15px;padding:20px;margin-bottom:24px}.ui-balance div>span{font-size:11px;color:#8490a2}.ui-balance strong{display:block;font-size:36px;font-weight:780;line-height:1.25;letter-spacing:-.05em;margin-top:4px}.ui-balance strong small{font-size:12px;color:#8793a5;margin-left:6px;font-weight:600}.ui-stock-state{font-size:10px;background:white;border:1px solid #e2e8f3;color:#73829a;border-radius:6px;padding:5px 8px}.ui-stock-state.is-low{color:#b26733;background:#fff8f0;border-color:#f4e4cf}

<style id="archicell-v39">/* ===== v3.9 회사 로고 헤더 · 여백 정리 · 요약/목록 · 사진 등록 · 반응형 ===== */
:root{--ink:#16191e;--muted:#6b7380;--line:#e3e6eb;--paper:#f4f5f7;--soft:#f7f8fa;--ui-radius:10px;--hd-h:64px}
body{font-size:15px;letter-spacing:-.015em}
/* 헤더: 왼쪽 로고 · 오른쪽 QR 스캔/구글 시트 · 작업자 */
header{position:relative;padding:0!important;background:#fff!important;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)!important;z-index:900}
header .hd{max-width:1440px;margin:0 auto;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;min-height:var(--hd-h);box-sizing:border-box;
  padding:max(8px,env(safe-area-inset-top,0px)) max(24px,env(safe-area-inset-right,0px)) 8px max(24px,env(safe-area-inset-left,0px))}
.hd-brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;min-width:0;flex-shrink:0}
.hd-brand img{height:42px;width:auto;display:block}
.hd-sub{font-size:13px;font-weight:650;color:var(--muted);padding-left:12px;border-left:1px solid var(--line);white-space:nowrap}
.hd-tools{margin-left:auto;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.hd-user{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.hd-menu,.hd-pad{display:none}
#identity{font-size:13px;padding:8px 12px;border-radius:8px;background:var(--soft);color:#3b4350;white-space:nowrap}
#company-logout{min-height:38px!important;font-size:13px!important;padding:6px 12px!important;border-radius:8px!important;margin:0!important;color:#4a5260!important;border:1px solid var(--line)!important;background:#fff!important}
header #ac-actions{display:flex!important;gap:8px!important;width:auto!important;flex:0 0 auto!important;margin:0!important;font-family:inherit!important}
header #ac-actions .ac-btn{height:40px!important;font-size:14px!important;font-weight:700!important;padding:0 14px!important;border-radius:8px!important;gap:7px!important}
header #ac-actions .ac-btn svg{width:18px;height:18px}
header #ac-actions #ac-qr{background:var(--accent)!important;border:1px solid var(--accent)!important;color:#fff!important}
header #ac-actions #ac-sheet{background:#fff!important;border:1px solid var(--line)!important;color:var(--ink)!important}
/* 영문 장식·중복 안내 정리 */
.ui-eyebrow,.ui-version,.page-intro,.ui-panel-kicker,.dashboard-metrics{display:none!important}
main{padding:18px 24px 40px;padding-left:max(24px,env(safe-area-inset-left,0px));padding-right:max(24px,env(safe-area-inset-right,0px))}
.app-toolbar{margin-bottom:14px!important}
.ui-heading{margin:0 0 12px}.ui-heading h1{font-size:24px;margin:0;letter-spacing:-.035em}.ui-heading p{font-size:13px;margin:2px 0 0}
/* 요약 카드: 세 칸 같은 크기 · 숫자 크게, 단위 작게 · 왼쪽 정렬 */
.ui-overview{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px;margin:0 0 16px}
.ui-overview>div,.ui-overview>button{min-height:0;padding:14px 18px;border-radius:var(--ui-radius);box-shadow:none;border:1px solid var(--line);background:#fff;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;text-align:left}
.ui-overview .ov-label{font-size:13px;font-weight:650;color:var(--muted);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}
.ui-overview .ov-num{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:baseline;gap:2px 12px;margin:0;line-height:1.15}
.ui-overview .ov-num b{display:inline;font-size:34px;font-weight:780;letter-spacing:-.035em;margin:0;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:var(--ink)}
.ui-overview .ov-num small{font-size:15px;font-weight:650;color:var(--muted);margin-left:3px}
.ui-overview .ov-foot{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:2px}
.ui-overview .ui-low{background:#fff;border-color:var(--line);cursor:pointer}
.ui-overview .ui-low.has-low{background:#fff6f1;border-color:#f3d6c6}.ui-overview .ui-low.has-low .ov-num b{color:#b4451f}
.ui-overview .ui-low:hover{border-color:var(--accent)}
/* 재고 목록 */
.rows-list{gap:8px}
.srow{grid-template-columns:64px minmax(200px,280px) minmax(0,1fr) 112px!important;gap:16px!important;padding:12px 16px!important;border-radius:var(--ui-radius)!important;box-shadow:none!important;align-items:center!important}
.srow .sc-photo{width:64px!important;height:64px!important;flex:0 0 64px!important;border-radius:8px!important}
.srow .sr-title{display:block;font-size:17px;font-weight:760;line-height:1.3;color:var(--ink);overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.srow .sr-meta{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:3px 10px;margin-top:4px;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.5}
.srow .sr-meta .sr-code{font-weight:700;color:#3b4350;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.srow .sr-meta .sr-m{font-size:11.5px;font-weight:700;color:#5d6b82;background:var(--soft);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:5px;padding:0 6px}
.srow .lowtag{font-size:11.5px;font-weight:700;color:#b4451f;background:#fff1ea;border-radius:5px;padding:0 6px}
.srow-lens{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;align-content:center}
.srow .lchip{font-size:13px;min-height:34px;padding:5px 10px;border-radius:7px}
.srow .lchip b{font-size:16px;font-weight:760;margin-left:6px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.srow-total{text-align:right;border-left:1px solid var(--line);padding-left:14px;align-self:stretch;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center}
.srow-total small{display:block;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:600}
.srow-total b{font-size:28px!important;font-weight:780;letter-spacing:-.03em;line-height:1.15;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;white-space:nowrap}
.srow-total b i{display:inline!important;font-size:13px;font-style:normal;color:var(--muted);margin-left:3px;font-weight:650}
.dash{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 300px;gap:18px}
.dash-side{padding:16px;border-radius:var(--ui-radius)}
/* 사진 등록 영역 */
.ph-zone{border:1.5px dashed #c9d0db;border-radius:var(--ui-radius);background:var(--soft);padding:14px;outline:none;transition:border-color .15s,background .15s;cursor:default}
.ph-zone:focus-visible,.ph-zone.ready{border-color:var(--accent);background:#f3f6ff}
.ph-zone.drag{border-color:var(--accent);border-style:solid;background:#eaf0ff}
.ph-zone.is-off{opacity:.55;pointer-events:none}
.ph-empty{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px}
.ph-empty>svg{flex:0 0 40px;width:40px;height:40px;color:#9aa3b2}
.ph-empty>div{flex:1;min-width:0}
.ph-empty b{display:block;font-size:14.5px;color:var(--ink)}
.ph-empty small{display:block;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:2px}
.ph-btn{min-height:42px;padding:8px 16px;border-radius:8px;font-weight:700;white-space:nowrap}
.ph-btn.primary{background:var(--accent);border:1px solid var(--accent);color:#fff}
.ph-has{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px}
.ph-thumb{flex:0 0 96px;width:96px;height:96px;padding:0;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;background:#fff;overflow:hidden;cursor:zoom-in}
.ph-thumb img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain;display:block}
.ph-side{flex:1;min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px}
.ph-state{font-size:14px;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink)}
.ph-state.busy{color:var(--accent)}.ph-state.ok{color:#1f7a4d}.ph-state.err{color:#b4451f}
.ph-side small{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted);white-space:pre-wrap}
.ph-acts{display:flex;gap:8px;margin-top:4px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.ph-acts button{min-height:38px;padding:6px 14px;border-radius:8px;font-size:13.5px}
.ph-acts .danger{color:#b4451f}
.ph-url{margin-top:8px;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted)}.ph-url summary{cursor:pointer;padding:4px 0}.ph-url input{margin-top:6px}
#company-login>small:first-of-type{display:none}
.login-logo{display:block;height:54px;width:auto;margin:0 0 18px}
@media(max-width:1100px){
 .srow{grid-template-columns:64px minmax(170px,230px) minmax(0,1fr) 104px!important}
 .dash{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)!important;display:block}
 .dash-side{display:block!important;position:static!important;margin-top:16px}
}
/* 휴대폰: 로고 정중앙 · 메뉴는 왼쪽 버튼 · QR 스캔은 로고 아래 큰 버튼 */

  padding:max(10px,env(safe-area-inset-top,0px)) max(14px,env(safe-area-inset-right,0px)) 12px max(14px,env(safe-area-inset-left,0px))}

  background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--ui-radius);padding:12px;box-shadow:0 12px 32px #15203a1f;opacity:0;transform:translateY(-6px);pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .15s,transform .15s}

 .ui-heading{margin-bottom:10px}.ui-heading h1{font-size:21px}.ui-heading p{display:none}
