 .ui-overview .ov-total{grid-column:1/-1;order:-1}
 .ui-overview>div,.ui-overview>button{padding:12px 14px;min-height:0}
 .ui-overview .ov-label{font-size:12.5px}
 .ui-overview .ov-num b{font-size:28px}.ui-overview .ov-num small{font-size:13.5px}
 .ui-overview .ov-foot{display:none}
 .srow{grid-template-columns:56px minmax(0,1fr) auto!important;grid-template-areas:"ph info total" "lens lens lens";gap:10px 12px!important;padding:12px!important;align-items:center!important}
 .srow .sc-photo{grid-area:ph;width:56px!important;height:56px!important;flex-basis:56px!important}
 .srow .srow-info{grid-area:info;min-width:0;align-self:center}
 .srow .srow-total{grid-area:total;border-left:0;padding-left:0;align-self:center}
 .srow .srow-lens{grid-area:lens}
 .srow .sr-title{font-size:16px}
 .srow .sr-meta{font-size:12px;gap:2px 8px}
 .srow-total b{font-size:24px!important}
 .srow .lchip{min-height:36px}
 .dash-side{margin-top:14px}
 .ph-empty{flex-wrap:wrap}.ph-empty .ph-btn{width:100%;min-height:46px}
 .ph-thumb{flex-basis:84px;width:84px;height:84px}
 .ph-acts button{min-height:42px;flex:1}
}
@media(max-width:380px){header #ac-actions .ac-btn{font-size:14px!important;padding:0 6px!important}.srow-total b{font-size:21px!important}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.hd-user{transition:none}}

/* ===== v3.9.1 눈이 덜 피곤한 화면: 글씨체 Pretendard · 굵기/대비 낮춤 · 사진 영역 가로 배치 · M코드 원래 위치 ===== */
:root{--ink:#2a2f37;--muted:#727a87;--line:#e7eaee;--paper:#f6f7f9;--soft:#f8f9fb}
body,button,input,select,textarea,#company-login,#company-login input,#company-login select{font-family:"Pretendard Variable",Pretendard,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Apple SD Gothic Neo","Malgun Gothic",sans-serif!important}
body{color:var(--ink);background:var(--paper);letter-spacing:-.01em;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
.ui-heading h1{font-size:22px;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink)}
.ui-heading p{color:var(--muted)}
.ui-overview .ov-label{font-weight:600}
.ui-overview .ov-num b{font-size:28px;font-weight:650;letter-spacing:-.02em;color:var(--ink)}
.ui-overview .ov-num small{font-size:14px;font-weight:500}
.srow{border-color:var(--line)!important}
.srow .sr-mtop{display:block;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:650;color:var(--accent);letter-spacing:.02em;margin-bottom:2px}
.srow .sr-title{font-size:16px;font-weight:650;color:var(--ink);letter-spacing:-.015em}
.srow .sr-meta{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted)}
.srow .sr-meta .sr-code{font-weight:600;color:#4a515c}
.srow .lchip{background:var(--soft)!important;border:1px solid var(--line)!important;color:#5b6370!important;font-size:13px;font-weight:500}
.srow .lchip b{font-size:15px;font-weight:650;color:var(--ink)}
.srow .lchip.low{background:#fff6f1!important;border-color:#f1d9cb!important;color:#a8512c!important}.srow .lchip.low b{color:#a8512c}
.srow-total small{font-weight:500}
.srow-total b{font-size:24px!important;font-weight:650!important;color:var(--ink)}
.srow .sc-photo{background:var(--soft)!important;border-color:var(--line)!important}
/* 사진 등록 영역: 버튼이 폭을 다 차지하지 않게 */
.ph-zone button{width:auto}
.ph-empty .ph-btn{flex:0 0 auto;width:auto;padding:8px 18px;font-size:14px;font-weight:650}
.ph-empty b{font-size:14.5px;font-weight:650}
.ph-acts button{width:auto}
@media(max-width:760px){
 .srow .sr-title{font-size:15.5px}
 .srow-total b{font-size:21px!important}
 .ui-overview .ov-num b{font-size:25px}
 .ph-empty .ph-btn{width:100%}
}

/* ===== v3.9.2 헤더 글자 ===== */
.hd-sub{font-size:19px;font-weight:700;color:#16191e;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.hd-title{display:none}
@media(max-width:760px){
 header .hd{grid-template-columns:76px minmax(0,1fr) 76px;grid-template-areas:"brand title menu" "tools tools tools"}
 .hd-brand{grid-area:brand;justify-self:start}
 .hd-brand img{height:30px}
 .hd-title{display:flex;grid-area:title;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:4px;min-width:0}
 .hd-title b{font-size:23px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.01em;color:#111418;line-height:1.1;white-space:nowrap}
 .hd-title span{font-size:11.5px;font-weight:600;color:#5c6470;background:#f1f3f6;border-radius:999px;padding:2px 10px}
 .hd-menu{grid-area:menu;justify-self:end;border:0;background:transparent}
 .hd-menu svg{width:26px;height:26px}
 .hd-pad{display:none!important}
}

/* ===== v3.9.3 휴대폰 메뉴: ☰ 바로 아래 오른쪽 작은 메뉴 · 이름은 글자 · 나가기는 붉은 글자 ===== */
@media(max-width:760px){
 .hd-user{left:auto!important;right:max(10px,env(safe-area-inset-right,0px))!important;top:calc(max(10px,env(safe-area-inset-top,0px)) + 52px)!important;width:240px;max-width:calc(100vw - 20px);padding:12px!important;gap:10px!important;transform-origin:top right}
 #identity{background:transparent!important;padding:2px 4px 0!important;text-align:left!important;font-size:15px!important;font-weight:650;color:var(--ink)!important}
 #identity::before{content:"접속 중";display:block;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:500;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:2px}
 #company-logout{color:#c2410c!important;border-color:#f1d5c4!important;background:#fff!important;font-weight:650!important}
 #company-logout:active{background:#fff4ec!important}
}

/* ===== v3.9.4 휴대폰: 로고는 심볼만 (가운데 ARCHICELL과 회사 이름 중복 방지) ===== */
.hd-symbol{display:none}
@media(max-width:760px){
 .hd-brand img.hd-logo{display:none}
 .hd-brand img.hd-symbol{display:block;height:34px;width:auto}
}

/* ===== v3.9.5 가운데 글자: 로고와 같은 글꼴(로고에서 잘라낸 이미지) ===== */
@media(max-width:760px){
 .hd-title{gap:6px}
 .hd-title img.hd-word{display:block;height:22px;width:auto;max-width:100%}
}

/* ===== v3.9.7 PC에서 심볼이 함께 보이던 문제 수정 (휴대폰만 심볼) ===== */
.hd-brand img.hd-symbol{display:none}
@media(max-width:760px){.hd-brand img.hd-symbol{display:block}}
</style>

<style id="archicell-v397-history">/* ===== v3.9.7 입출고 기록 화면만 (#view-history 안에서만 적용) ===== */
#view-history>.card{padding:18px 22px}
#view-history>.card>p.muted:first-of-type{margin:0 0 12px}
#view-history .grid{gap:12px;margin-bottom:10px}
#view-history label{font-size:13px;margin-bottom:6px}
#view-history select,#view-history input{min-height:46px;font-size:15px}
#view-history .log-summary{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:4px 12px;margin:4px 0 10px;font-size:14px;color:var(--ink)}
#view-history .log-summary .sep{width:1px;height:12px;background:var(--line)}
#view-history .log-summary small{flex-basis:100%;font-size:12px}
#view-history .t-in{color:#1f7a4d;font-weight:650}#view-history .t-out{color:#c2410c;font-weight:650}
#view-history .tablewrap{overflow-x:auto}
#view-history .h-table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;table-layout:fixed}
#view-history .h-table th{font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:var(--muted);text-align:left;padding:10px 12px;background:var(--soft);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
#view-history .h-table td{padding:13px 12px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);vertical-align:top;font-size:14.5px;color:var(--ink)}
#view-history th.h-date{width:118px}#view-history th.h-type{width:118px}#view-history th.h-qty{width:170px}#view-history th.h-who{width:24%}#view-history th.h-cancel{width:120px;text-align:center}
#view-history td.h-date{font-size:13.5px;color:var(--muted);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;white-space:nowrap}
#view-history .h-name{display:block;font-size:16px;font-weight:650;line-height:1.35;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
#view-history .h-sub{display:block;font-size:14px;color:#3f4651;margin-top:3px;font-weight:500}
#view-history .h-code{display:block;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:3px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
#view-history .h-badge{display:inline-block;font-size:13px;font-weight:650;padding:3px 9px;border-radius:6px;background:var(--soft);border:1px solid var(--line);color:#4a515c}
#view-history .tone-in .h-badge{background:#eef8f2;border-color:#cfe9da;color:#1f7a4d}
#view-history .tone-out .h-badge{background:#fff3ec;border-color:#f3d6c6;color:#c2410c}
#view-history .tone-cancel .h-badge{background:#f3f4f6;border-color:#e2e4e8;color:#6b7280;text-decoration:line-through}
#view-history td.h-type small{display:block;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:5px}
#view-history .h-delta{display:block;font-size:20px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.2;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:var(--ink)}
#view-history .h-delta i{font-style:normal;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;margin-left:2px;color:var(--muted)}
#view-history .tone-in .h-delta{color:#1f7a4d}#view-history .tone-out .h-delta{color:#c2410c}#view-history .tone-cancel .h-delta{color:#6b7280}
#view-history td.h-qty small{display:block;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:3px}
#view-history td.h-who b{display:block;font-size:14.5px;font-weight:600}
#view-history td.h-who span{display:block;font-size:13.5px;color:#4f5763;margin-top:2px;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
#view-history td.h-who .h-date-m{display:none}
#view-history td.h-cancel{text-align:center}
#view-history .h-cancel-btn{width:auto;min-height:38px;padding:6px 16px;font-size:14px;border-radius:8px;background:#fff;border:1px solid #f1d5c4;color:#c2410c;font-weight:650}
#view-history .h-state{display:inline-block;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted)}
#view-history .h-state.is-canceled{color:#6b7280;font-weight:650;background:#f3f4f6;border-radius:6px;padding:2px 8px;margin-top:5px}
#view-history tr.is-canceled td{background:#fafafa}#view-history tr.is-canceled .h-name,#view-history tr.is-canceled .h-delta{opacity:.6}
#view-history .h-empty{padding:24px 0;text-align:center}
@media(max-width:760px){
 #view-history>.card{padding:14px}
 #view-history .grid{grid-template-columns:1fr!important}
 #view-history .tablewrap{overflow:visible}
 #view-history .h-table,#view-history .h-table tbody{display:block;width:100%!important;min-width:0!important}
 #view-history .h-table tr.h-row{box-sizing:border-box;width:100%}
 #view-history .h-table td{min-width:0;white-space:normal!important}
 #view-history .h-table thead{display:none}
 #view-history .h-table tr.h-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto;grid-template-areas:"item item" "type qty" "who who" "cancel cancel";gap:8px 12px;
   border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;background:#fff;padding:12px 14px;margin-bottom:10px}
 #view-history .h-table td{display:block;padding:0;border:0;background:transparent!important}
 #view-history td.h-date{display:none}
 #view-history td.h-item{grid-area:item}
 #view-history td.h-type{grid-area:type;align-self:center}
 #view-history td.h-qty{grid-area:qty;text-align:right}
 #view-history td.h-who{grid-area:who;border-top:1px solid var(--line)!important;padding-top:8px}
 #view-history td.h-who b,#view-history td.h-who span{display:inline;margin:0}
 #view-history td.h-who span::before{content:" · "}
 #view-history td.h-who .h-date-m{display:inline;color:var(--muted)}
 #view-history td.h-cancel{grid-area:cancel;text-align:left}
 #view-history td.h-cancel:has(.h-state:not(.is-canceled)){display:none}
 #view-history .h-cancel-btn{width:100%;min-height:44px}
 #view-history .h-delta{font-size:21px}
}
</style>
<style id="archicell-v398-history">/* ===== v3.9.8 입출고 기록: 도구 줄 · 날짜/시간 두 줄 · 더 보기 (#view-history 안에서만 적용) ===== */
#view-history .h-tools{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:8px 14px;margin:2px 0 12px}
#view-history .h-seg{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px}
#view-history .h-chip{width:auto;min-height:38px;padding:6px 14px;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;border-radius:999px;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);color:#4a515c;cursor:pointer}
#view-history .h-chip.on{background:#eaf0ff;border-color:#b9cbff;color:#2447c9}
#view-history .h-chip.h-csv{margin-left:auto;border-radius:8px}
#view-history td.h-date{white-space:nowrap}
#view-history td.h-date b{display:block;font-size:14.5px;font-weight:650;color:var(--ink);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
#view-history td.h-date span{display:block;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:3px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
#view-history .h-hidden-note{display:block;margin:4px 0 10px;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted)}
#view-history .h-more{display:flex;justify-content:center;margin:14px 0 4px}
#view-history .h-more button{width:auto;min-height:44px;padding:8px 28px;font-size:15px;font-weight:650;border-radius:10px;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--ink);cursor:pointer}
@media (max-width:720px){#view-history .h-chip.h-csv{margin-left:0}#view-history .h-chip{min-height:42px}}
</style>
<style id="archicell-v399-side">/* ===== v3.9.9 현황 오른쪽 패널 정리 (.dash-side 안에서만 적용) ===== */
.dash-side .today{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin:10px 0 14px}
.dash-side .today .tchip{display:inline-flex;align-items:baseline;gap:6px;padding:8px 14px;border-radius:10px;background:#f5f6f8;border:1px solid #eceef2;font-size:14px;color:#4a515c}
.dash-side .today .tchip b{font-size:20px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.02em;color:#1d2120;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.dash-side .side-low{margin:0 0 16px}
.dash-side .low-alert{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;width:100%;min-height:44px;padding:10px 14px;border-radius:10px;background:#fff3ec;border:1px solid #f3d6c6;color:#b4532a;font-size:14px;font-weight:650;text-align:left}
.dash-side .low-list{margin-top:6px}
.dash-side .low-list .lowrow{padding:10px 4px;font-size:14px}
.dash-side .low-list .lowrow b{font-size:14px}
.dash-side .low-more{display:block;padding:8px 4px 0;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted)}
.dash-side .low-ok{display:block;font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);padding:2px 2px 0}
.dash-side .side-head-recent{margin-bottom:6px}
.dash-side .side-head h2{font-size:15px}
.dash-side .act{gap:12px;padding:12px 0;font-size:13px}
.dash-side .act-type{font-size:12px;min-width:48px;padding:4px 8px}
.dash-side .act-main b{font-size:14.5px}
.dash-side .act-main small{font-size:12.5px;color:#5b626c}
.dash-side .act strong{font-size:17px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.dash-side .act-type.t-in{background:#eef8f2;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px #cfe9da;color:#1f7a4d}
.dash-side .act-type.t-out{background:#fff3ec;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px #f3d6c6;color:#c2410c}
.dash-side .act.in strong{color:#1f7a4d}.dash-side .act.out strong{color:#c2410c}
.dash-side .side-note{margin:10px 0 0;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);text-align:center}
</style>
<style id="archicell-v3910-sort">/* ===== v3.9.10 현황 목록: 색상 구분 제목 ===== */
#stock-list .sc-group{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:8px;margin:10px 2px 0;padding:0 0 6px;border-bottom:1px solid #e6e8ea;font-size:14px;color:#1d2120}
#stock-list .sc-group:first-child{margin-top:0}
#stock-list .sc-group b{font-size:15px;font-weight:700}
#stock-list .sc-group span{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted)}
</style>
<style id="archicell-v310-manage">/* ===== v3.10 관리 화면 가로 배치 · QR 라벨 · 그룹 제목 · 메모 수정 ===== */
.management-layout{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)!important;gap:16px!important}
.item-card{padding:22px 24px}
.if-top{max-width:560px}
.if-main{display:grid;grid-template-columns:270px minmax(0,1fr);gap:26px;align-items:start;margin-top:4px}
.if-photo .form-sec,.if-fields>.form-sec{margin-top:14px}
.if-photo .ph-zone{padding:14px}
.if-photo .ph-empty{flex-direction:column;text-align:center;gap:10px;padding:8px 0}
.if-photo .ph-empty svg{width:44px;height:44px}
.if-photo .ph-btn{width:100%}
.if-photo .ph-has{flex-direction:column}
.if-photo .ph-thumb{flex:0 0 auto;width:100%;height:170px}
.if-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr))!important;gap:12px 14px;margin-top:10px}
.if-memo{min-width:0}
.name-preview{margin:14px 0 0;padding:10px 14px;border-radius:10px;background:#f2f6ff;border:1px solid #dbe5ff;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;color:#2447c9}
.name-preview:empty{display:none}
.if-foot{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px 18px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:18px;padding-top:16px;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.if-foot .check{margin:0}
.if-foot p{margin:0;flex:1;min-width:220px;font-size:12px}
.if-foot button.primary{width:auto;min-width:200px}
#delete-item{width:auto!important;margin-top:0!important}
.audit-box{padding:0!important}
.audit-box>summary{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;min-height:54px;padding:12px 22px;cursor:pointer;list-style:none;font-size:16px}
.audit-box>summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
.audit-box>summary small{color:var(--muted);font-size:12.5px;flex:1}
.audit-box>summary::after{content:"▾";color:var(--muted);font-size:14px}
.audit-box[open]>summary::after{content:"▴"}
.audit-box[open]>summary{border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.audit-box>fieldset,.audit-box>p{margin-left:22px;margin-right:22px}
.audit-box>fieldset{max-width:640px;margin-bottom:22px}
@media (max-width:1100px){.if-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))!important}}
@media (max-width:860px){.if-main{grid-template-columns:1fr}.if-photo .ph-empty{flex-direction:row;text-align:left}.if-photo .ph-has{flex-direction:row}.if-photo .ph-thumb{width:96px;height:96px}}
@media (max-width:560px){.if-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr!important}.if-foot button.primary{width:100%}.item-card{padding:16px}}
#stock-list .sc-group .sc-dot{display:inline-block;width:11px;height:11px;border-radius:50%;margin-right:2px;align-self:center;border:1px solid #c9ced6}
.qrm .ql-m{display:block;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:#2447c9;margin-bottom:2px}
.qrm .ql-sub{display:block;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:4px}
#history .h-memo-btn{width:auto;min-height:30px;padding:3px 10px;margin-top:6px;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;border-radius:8px;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);color:#4a515c;cursor:pointer}
@media (max-width:720px){#history .h-memo-btn{min-height:38px}}
</style>

<section id="company-login" aria-label="회사 재고관리 접속">
<img class="login-logo" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Archi Cell" width="384" height="169"><small>ARCHICELL / STOCK</small><h1>회사 재고관리</h1><p>처음 한 번만 인증하면, 다음부터 바로 재고관리 화면이 열립니다.</p>
<form id="company-form">
<label for="company-role">접속 구분</label><select id="company-role"><option value="staff">직원 · 조회 및 입출고</option><option value="admin">관리자 · 품목 및 재고 관리</option></select>
<label for="company-name">작업자 이름</label><select id="company-name" required><option value="" disabled selected>이름을 선택하세요</option><option value="강세윤">강세윤</option><option value="박일">박일</option><option value="이우현">이우현</option></select>
<label for="company-password">회사 비밀번호</label><input id="company-password" type="password" maxlength="256" required autocomplete="current-password" placeholder="공유받은 비밀번호">
<button id="company-enter" type="submit">접속하기</button><p id="login-error" role="alert"></p>
</form><small>비밀번호 4자 이상 · 직접 나갈 때까지 자동 접속 유지</small></section>

<header><div class="hd"><button id="hd-menu" class="hd-menu" type="button" aria-label="작업자 메뉴" aria-expanded="false" onclick="hdMenu()"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 7h16M4 12h16M4 17h16"/></svg></button><div class="hd-brand"><img class="hd-logo" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Archi Cell" width="384" height="169"><img class="hd-symbol" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="" aria-hidden="true" width="189" height="166"><span class="hd-sub">자재관리 통합시스템</span></div><div class="hd-title"><img class="hd-word" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="ArchiCell" width="881" height="119"></div><div id="hd-tools" class="hd-tools"></div><div class="hd-user"><span id="identity">접속 확인 중…</span><button id="company-logout" onclick="logoutCompany()">작업자 변경 / 나가기</button></div></div></header>
<main>
<div class="app-toolbar"><nav aria-label="기능"><button data-view="stock" class="active" onclick="show('stock')">현황</button><button data-view="history" onclick="show('history')">기록</button><button data-view="manage" class="admin-only hidden" onclick="show('manage')">관리</button><button data-view="labels" onclick="show('labels')">QR 라벨</button></nav>
<div class="row spread status"><span id="sync">불러오는 중…</span><button id="reload" onclick="load(false)">↻ 새로고침</button></div></div><div class="page-intro"><div><span class="section-kicker">ARCHICELL / OPERATIONS</span><h1 id="page-title">재고 현황</h1><p id="page-subtitle">전체 수량과 품목별 재고를 확인하세요.</p></div><span class="system-badge">QR 1개로 입고·출고</span></div><div id="dashboard-metrics" class="dashboard-metrics" aria-label="재고 요약"></div>
<div class="ui-heading"><div><div class="ui-eyebrow">WORKSPACE / MATERIALS</div><h1 id="ui-title">재고 현황</h1><p id="ui-subtitle">필요한 자재를 찾고, 바로 입출고하세요.</p></div><span class="ui-version">STOCK · 3.8</span></div>
<div id="ui-overview" class="ui-overview" aria-label="재고 요약"></div>
<div id="global" role="status" aria-live="polite" class="message hidden"></div>
<div id="pending-box" class="message error hidden"><b>저장 결과 확인이 필요합니다.</b><p id="pending-summary"></p><p class="muted">같은 요청으로 다시 보내도 중복 기록되지 않습니다. 확인 전에는 새 작업이 잠깁니다.</p><button id="retry" onclick="sendPending()">같은 요청 재시도</button></div>

<!-- 입고·출고 -->
<section id="view-work" class="hidden"><div class="work-board">  <div id="finder" class="card">
    <div class="hint no-item"><span class="icon">⌗</span><div><b>QR 스캔 또는 자재 검색</b><span class="muted">휴대폰 카메라로 QR을 열거나 이름·규격·위치로 찾으세요.</span></div></div>
    <span class="section-kicker">01 / MATERIAL</span><h2>자재 찾기</h2>
    <div class="scanrow"><input id="find" aria-label="자재 이름·코드·규격·위치 검색" maxlength="1000" autocomplete="off" placeholder="이름·코드·위치 (스캐너 입력 가능)" oninput="renderFind()" onkeydown="if(event.key==='Enter'){event.preventDefault();findEnter();}"><button type="button" onclick="findEnter()">열기</button></div>
    <div id="find-list" class="find-list"></div>
  </div>

<div class="transaction-panel card"><span class="section-kicker">02 / MOVEMENT</span><div class="empty-work no-item"><div class="empty-symbol">↗ ↙</div><h1>자재를 선택하면<br>입출고가 시작됩니다.</h1><p>왼쪽에서 자재를 고르거나 보관대 QR을 찍으세요.</p><div class="empty-steps"><span><b>01</b> 자재 선택</span><span><b>02</b> 입고·출고 수량</span><span><b>03</b> 기록 완료</span></div></div>  <div id="item-card" class="card item-card need-item">
    <div class="item-top"><span><span id="selected-order" class="order-chip"></span><span id="selected-category" class="category-badge"></span></span><button type="button" class="ghost" onclick="focusFind()">다른 자재</button></div>
    <div class="sel-head"><span id="selected-photo" class="sc-photo"></span><div class="sel-info">
      <div class="kv"><em>품목명</em><h1 id="selected-name"></h1></div>
      <div class="kv"><em>코드</em><span id="selected-code"></span></div>
      <div class="kv" id="selected-size-row"><em>크기</em><span id="selected-size"></span></div>
      <p id="selected-detail" class="muted"></p></div></div>
    <div id="selected-lens" class="lc-grid"></div>
    <div class="stock-line"><span class="muted" id="balance-label">현재 재고</span><strong><span id="balance">—</span><small id="balance-unit">EA</small></strong></div>
    <div id="selected-low" class="low"></div>
  </div>

<div id="operation-choice" class="operation-choice need-item"><span class="section-kicker">작업 선택</span><h2>입고인가요, 출고인가요?</h2><p class="muted">작업 하나를 고르면 해당 수량 버튼만 열립니다.</p><div class="operation-options"><button id="choose-out" class="operation-option out-option" type="button" onclick="chooseOperation('출고')"><span>↗</span><b>출고</b><small>자재를 꺼낼 때</small></button><button id="choose-in" class="operation-option in-option" type="button" onclick="chooseOperation('입고')"><span>↙</span><b>입고</b><small>자재를 넣거나 반납할 때</small></button><button id="choose-cut" class="operation-option cut-option hidden" type="button" onclick="chooseOperation('절단')"><span>✂</span><b>절단</b><small>원래 길이를 잘라 다른 길이로 만들 때</small></button></div></div><div id="operation-toolbar" class="operation-toolbar hidden need-item"><b id="operation-selected"></b><button id="change-operation" class="ghost" type="button" onclick="resetOperation()">작업 다시 선택</button></div>
<div id="len-panel" class="len-panel hidden need-item"><b id="len-title">길이를 고르세요</b><div id="len-chips" class="len-chips"></div>
<div id="len-new" class="len-new hidden"><input id="len-new-input" type="number" inputmode="numeric" min="1" max="100000" step="1" placeholder="새 길이 (mm) 예: 1200" onkeydown="if(event.key==='Enter'){event.preventDefault();useNewLen();}"><button type="button" onclick="useNewLen()">이 길이로 입고</button></div></div><div class="movement-grid"><div id="lane-out" class="lane outbound need-item hidden">
    <div class="lane-head"><h2>↗ 출고</h2><span>보관대에서 꺼낼 때 · 누르면 바로 저장</span></div>
    <div class="qty" id="out-qty"></div>
    <button id="out-direct" class="direct" type="button" onclick="openDirect('출고')">다른 수량 · 메모 남기기</button>
  </div>
  <div id="lane-in" class="lane need-item hidden">
    <div class="lane-head"><h2>↙ 입고</h2><span>새 자재·미사용 반납 · 누르면 바로 저장</span></div>
    <div class="qty" id="in-qty"></div>
    <button id="in-direct" class="direct" type="button" onclick="openDirect('입고')">다른 수량 · 메모 남기기</button>
  </div>

</div><div id="custom-panel" class="card custom-panel hidden need-item">
    <h2 id="custom-title">직접 수량 입력</h2>
    <label for="quantity">수량 (<span id="quantity-unit">EA</span>)</label><input id="quantity" type="number" inputmode="numeric" min="1" max="1000000" step="1" oninput="updateDirect()" onkeydown="if(event.key==='Enter'){event.preventDefault();submitDirect();}">
    <label for="memo">메모 (선택) · 현장명·사용 목적</label><input id="memo" maxlength="250" placeholder="예: 분당 현장 반출">
    <p id="next-balance" class="muted"></p>
    <button id="custom-save" class="primary" type="button" onclick="submitDirect()">저장</button>
    <button type="button" onclick="closeDirect()" style="width:100%;margin-top:8px">닫기</button>
  </div>
  <div id="cut-panel" class="card cut-panel hidden need-item">
    <p class="muted" style="margin-top:0">원래 길이는 출고, 잘라서 나온 길이는 입고로 한 번에 기록됩니다. 남은 조각도 적어두면 재고로 남아요.</p>
    <div class="grid"><div><label for="cut-from">자를 원래 길이</label><select id="cut-from" onchange="updateCut()"></select></div>
    <div><label for="cut-count">자른 개수</label><input id="cut-count" type="number" inputmode="numeric" min="1" max="1000000" step="1" value="1" oninput="updateCut()"></div></div>
    <label>잘라서 나온 길이 × 개수</label>
    <div id="cut-rows"></div>
    <button type="button" class="ghost" style="margin-top:8px" onclick="addCutRow();updateCut()">+ 길이 추가</button>
    <label for="cut-memo">메모 (선택) · 현장명·용도</label><input id="cut-memo" maxlength="250" placeholder="예: 분당 현장 재단">
    <p id="cut-preview" class="muted"></p>
    <button id="cut-save" class="primary" type="button" onclick="submitCut()">절단 저장</button>
  </div>

  <div id="result" class="result hidden" role="status" aria-live="polite"><div><b id="result-main"></b><span id="result-sub"></span></div><button id="undo" type="button" onclick="undoLast()">되돌리기</button></div>

<p class="work-rule need-item">수량을 누르면 즉시 저장됩니다. 다른 수량과 현장 메모는 직접 입력을 이용하세요.</p></div></div><div class="work-bottom"><div class="card"><div class="panel-title"><h2>보충이 필요한 자재</h2><button class="text-button" onclick="stockFilter('low')">재고 확인 ↗</button></div><div id="shortages"></div></div><div class="card"><div class="panel-title"><h2>최근 작업</h2><button class="text-button" onclick="show('stock')">기록 전체 ↗</button></div><div id="work-recent"></div></div></div></section>

<!-- 재고·기록 -->
<section id="view-stock"><div class="dash">
<div class="dash-main">
  <div class="dash-tools"><div id="stock-chips" class="chips"></div><input id="search" aria-label="재고 검색" placeholder="품목·코드·크기·길이 검색 (예: 940)" oninput="renderStock()" autocomplete="off"></div>
  <div id="stock-list" class="rows-list"></div>
</div>
<aside class="dash-side card">
  <div class="side-head"><h2>오늘</h2><small id="today-date" class="muted"></small></div>
  <div id="today-stats" class="today"></div>
  <div id="side-low" class="side-low"></div>
  <div class="side-head side-head-recent"><h2>최근 입출고</h2><button class="text-button" onclick="show('history')">전체 기록 ↗</button></div>
  <div id="side-recent"></div>
  <p class="side-note">취소·기초재고 기록은 숨겼어요. 전체는 기록에서 볼 수 있습니다.</p>
</aside>
</div></section>
<section id="view-history" class="hidden"><div class="card"><p class="muted">작업자는 본인 입출고만 취소할 수 있습니다. 실사 이전 기록은 취소할 수 없습니다.</p><div class="grid"><div><label for="log-type">처리 종류</label><select id="log-type" onchange="renderHistory()"><option value="">전체</option><option>입고</option><option>출고</option><option>절단출고</option><option>절단입고</option><option>취소</option><option>실사조정</option><option>기초재고</option></select></div><div><label for="log-search">품목·크기·길이·코드·작업자·메모 검색</label><input id="log-search" oninput="renderHistory()" placeholder="예: 3060 · 940 · 실버 · 강세윤" autocomplete="off"></div></div><div class="h-tools" id="h-tools"><div class="h-seg" role="group" aria-label="기간"><button type="button" class="h-chip" data-hp="all" onclick="histSet('period','all')">최근 100건</button><button type="button" class="h-chip" data-hp="today" onclick="histSet('period','today')">오늘</button><button type="button" class="h-chip" data-hp="week" onclick="histSet('period','week')">이번 주</button><button type="button" class="h-chip" data-hp="month" onclick="histPeriod('month')">이번 달</button><button type="button" class="h-chip" data-hp="prev" onclick="histPeriod('prev')">지난 달</button><button type="button" class="h-chip" data-hp="range" onclick="histPeriod('range')">기간 지정…</button><button type="button" class="h-chip" data-hp="every" onclick="histPeriod('every')">전체 기간</button></div><div class="h-seg" role="group" aria-label="보기 옵션"><button type="button" class="h-chip" id="h-mine" aria-pressed="false" onclick="histToggle('mine')">내 기록만</button><button type="button" class="h-chip" id="h-cancel" aria-pressed="false" onclick="histToggle('showCancel')">취소 내역 보기</button><button type="button" class="h-chip" id="h-base" aria-pressed="false" onclick="histToggle('showBase')">기초재고 보기</button></div><button type="button" class="h-chip h-csv" onclick="histCsv()">엑셀(CSV) 내려받기</button></div><p id="log-summary" class="log-summary"></p><div class="tablewrap" id="history"></div></div></section>

<!-- 관리 -->
<section id="view-manage" class="hidden"><div class="management-layout"><div class="card item-card"><h2>품목 등록·수정</h2><fieldset id="item-fields" disabled><div class="if-top"><label for="edit-sku">관리할 품목</label><select id="edit-sku" onchange="editChanged()"><option value="">새 품목 등록</option></select></div><div class="if-main"><div class="if-photo"><div class="form-sec">사진</div>
<div id="ph-zone" class="ph-zone" tabindex="0" aria-label="품목 사진 등록. 사진 등록 버튼으로 고르거나, 이미지를 끌어다 놓거나, 이 영역을 누른 뒤 Ctrl+V로 붙여넣을 수 있습니다.">
 <div id="ph-empty" class="ph-empty"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><rect x="3" y="5" width="18" height="14" rx="2"/><circle cx="9" cy="10" r="1.8"/><path d="M21 16l-5-5-8 8"/></svg>
  <div><b id="ph-title">사진을 선택하거나 여기에 드래그하세요</b><small id="ph-tip">이미지를 복사한 후 Ctrl+V로 붙여넣을 수도 있습니다.</small></div>
  <button type="button" id="ph-pick" class="ph-btn primary" onclick="phPick()">사진 등록</button></div>
 <div id="ph-has" class="ph-has hidden"><button type="button" id="ph-thumb" class="ph-thumb" aria-label="사진 크게 보기" onclick="if(el('edit-sku').value&&!ph.staged)openPhoto(el('edit-sku').value)"><img id="ph-img" alt="품목 사진 미리보기" referrerpolicy="no-referrer"></button>
  <div class="ph-side"><span id="ph-state" class="ph-state"></span><small id="ph-note"></small>
   <div class="ph-acts"><button type="button" id="ph-retry" class="hidden" onclick="phUpload(el('edit-sku').value)">다시 시도</button><button type="button" id="ph-change" onclick="phPick()">변경</button><button type="button" id="ph-del" class="danger" onclick="phDelete()">삭제</button></div></div></div>
</div>
<input id="ph-file" type="file" accept="image/*" hidden>
<details class="ph-url"><summary>사진 주소로 넣기 (보조)</summary><label for="item-photo" class="hidden">사진 주소</label><input id="item-photo" maxlength="500" placeholder="https://… 구글 드라이브 공유 링크도 됩니다" autocomplete="off"></details>
</div><div class="if-fields"><div class="form-sec">기본 정보</div><div class="grid if-grid"><div><label for="item-code">품목코드</label><input id="item-code" maxlength="40" placeholder="예: QL-310" autocapitalize="characters"></div><div><label for="item-order">주문코드 (M코드)</label><input id="item-order" maxlength="20" placeholder="예: M187" autocapitalize="characters"></div><div><label for="item-kind">종류</label><input id="item-kind" oninput="updateNamePreview()" maxlength="30" list="kind-list" placeholder="골라도 되고 직접 써도 돼요" autocomplete="off"><datalist id="kind-list"><option value="프로파일"><option value="R반원"><option value="R코너"><option value="브라켓"><option value="볼트·너트"><option value="기타"></datalist></div><div><label for="item-size">크기</label><input id="item-size" oninput="updateNamePreview()" maxlength="30" placeholder="예: 20x40"></div><div><label for="item-color">색상</label><input id="item-color" oninput="updateNamePreview()" maxlength="8" list="color-list" placeholder="예: 블랙 / 실버 (없으면 비움)" autocomplete="off"><datalist id="color-list"><option value="블랙"><option value="실버"><option value="화이트"></datalist></div><div><label for="item-spec">두께 (선택)</label><input id="item-spec" maxlength="100" placeholder="예: 1.8mm"></div><div><label for="item-unit">단위</label><input id="item-unit" maxlength="20" value="EA" list="unit-list" placeholder="EA / 박스 / 봉"><datalist id="unit-list"><option value="EA"><option value="박스"><option value="봉"><option value="세트"></datalist></div><div id="base-wrap"><label for="item-base">기본 길이 (mm)</label><input id="item-base" type="number" inputmode="numeric" min="1" max="100000" step="1" placeholder="길이 관리 안 하면 비움"><small id="base-note" class="muted"></small></div><div id="initial-wrap"><label for="item-start">처음 수량 (기본 길이 기준)</label><input id="item-start" type="number" min="0" max="1000000" step="1" value="0"></div><div><label for="item-safety">부족 알림 기준 (이하)</label><input id="item-safety" type="number" min="0" max="1000000" step="1" value="0"></div><div><label for="item-location">보관 위치</label><input id="item-location" maxlength="60" placeholder="A구역 1번 랙"></div><div class="if-memo"><label for="item-memo">비고 (선택)</label><input id="item-memo" maxlength="250" placeholder="필요한 내용만 입력하세요"></div><div class="hidden"><select id="item-category"><option>원장</option><option>기타 자재</option><option>확인 필요</option></select></div></div><p id="name-preview" class="name-preview"></p><div id="code-note" class="hidden muted" style="font-size:11px;margin-top:6px">품목코드를 바꾸면 기존 입출고 기록과 예전 QR이 새 코드로 그대로 연결됩니다. 라벨은 새로 뽑는 걸 권장해요.</div></div></div><div id="count-wrap" class="hidden" style="background:#f5f4f0;border-radius:12px;padding:14px 15px;margin-top:14px">
<label style="margin-top:0">현재 수량 · 실제 개수와 다르면 고쳐주세요</label>
<div id="count-list" class="grid" style="grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(130px,1fr));gap:8px"></div>
<p class="muted" style="font-size:11px;margin:8px 0 0">바꾼 수량은 '실사조정'으로 기록에 남습니다. 새 길이 추가는 입출고 창에서 입고로 해주세요.</p></div>
<div id="photo-upload-wrap" class="hidden" style="display:none!important"><label for="item-photo-file">사진 올리기 · 휴대폰 카메라 가능</label><input id="item-photo-file" type="file" accept="image/*" onchange="uploadPhoto()"><small class="muted">올리면 바로 저장됩니다. 구글 드라이브 'ARCHICELL 자재사진' 폴더에 보관돼요.</small></div>
<div class="if-foot"><label class="check"><input id="item-active" type="checkbox" checked>사용 중</label><p class="muted">품목 저장을 한 번 누르면 코드·정보·수량이 함께 저장됩니다.</p><button class="primary" onclick="submitItem()">품목 저장</button><button id="delete-item" class="hidden" style="width:100%;margin-top:10px" onclick="deleteItem()">재고·이력 없는 품목 삭제</button></div></fieldset></div><details class="card audit-box" id="audit-box"><summary><b>재고 실사·조정</b><small>자주 쓰지 않아요 · 눌러서 열기</small></summary><p class="muted">세는 동안 자재 이동을 잠시 멈춰주세요. 확인 중 입출고가 생기면 다시 확인하도록 안내합니다.</p>
<fieldset id="audit-fields" disabled><label for="audit-sku">실사 품목</label><select id="audit-sku" onchange="auditChanged()"></select>
<div id="audit-len-wrap" class="hidden"><label for="audit-len">길이</label><select id="audit-len" onchange="auditLenChanged()"></select><input id="audit-len-new" class="hidden" type="number" inputmode="numeric" min="1" max="100000" step="1" placeholder="새 길이 (mm)" oninput="auditLenChanged()" style="margin-top:6px"></div><p id="audit-current" class="muted"></p><label for="count">직접 센 수량 (<span id="audit-unit">EA</span>)</label><input id="count" type="number" min="0" max="1000000" step="1" inputmode="numeric"><label for="audit-reason">조정 사유 (필수)</label><input id="audit-reason" maxlength="250" placeholder="예: 마감 실사, 출고 기록 누락 확인"><button class="primary" onclick="submitAudit()">실사 수량으로 조정</button></fieldset></details></div></section>

<section id="view-labels" class="hidden"><div class="card label-layout"><div class="noprint label-settings"><span class="section-kicker">LABEL STUDIO</span><h1>보관대 QR 라벨</h1><p class="muted">품목마다 QR 하나만 붙이면 됩니다. 찍으면 출고·입고 버튼이 함께 열립니다. 예전에 뽑은 QR도 그대로 쓸 수 있습니다.</p><label for="label-sku">인쇄할 품목</label><select id="label-sku" onchange="renderLabels()"></select><p class="pill">품목당 QR 1개 · 입고·출고 공용</p><button id="print" onclick="window.print()" style="width:100%;margin-top:6px" disabled>라벨 인쇄</button><p id="qr-status" class="muted"></p></div><div id="labels" class="labels"></div></div></section>

  <div class="qs-head"><span id="qs-photo" class="sc-photo" role="button" tabindex="0" title="사진 크게 보기" onclick="openPhoto(sel)"></span><div class="qs-title"><small id="qs-meta"></small><b id="qs-name"></b></div>

  <div id="ui-balance" class="ui-balance"></div><div id="qs-wdrow" class="qs-wd"><label for="qs-wd">작업일</label><input id="qs-wd" type="date" onchange="wdRender()" aria-describedby="qs-wd-note"><span id="qs-wd-note" class="qs-wd-note"></span><button id="qs-wd-today" type="button" class="qs-wd-reset hidden" onclick="wdReset()">오늘로</button></div><div id="qs-move">

  </div>

   <div class="qe-grid">
    <div><label for="qe-order">M코드</label><input id="qe-order" maxlength="20" autocapitalize="characters" autocomplete="off" placeholder="예: M187"></div>

<?!= include_('QRLib'); ?>
<script>
'use strict';
const QTY=[1,2,5,10];
const IDLE_RESET=10*60*1000;
const el=id=>document.getElementById(id);
const esc=s=>String(s??'').replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]));
const fmt=n=>Number(n).toLocaleString('ko-KR');
let initialSku=el('initial-sku').value.trim().toUpperCase(),initialAction=el('initial-action').value;
let db=null,busy=false,loading=false,pending=null,view='stock',sel='',lastTx=null,result=null,directType='',chosenType='';
let undoArmed=false,undoTimer=0,cooldown=false,auditSnapshot=null,formsReady=false,requestedEditCode='';
let loadSeq=0,appliedSeq=0,minSeq=0,hiddenAt=0;
// v3.0 길이별 재고
let chosenLen=null;const expanded=new Set();
const PHOTO_ICON='<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="22" height="22" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><rect x="3" y="5" width="18" height="14" rx="2"/><circle cx="9" cy="10" r="1.6"/><path d="M21 16l-5-5-8 8"/></svg>';
function visibleLengths(i){if(!i)return [];const ls=i.lengths&&i.lengths.length?i.lengths:[{mm:0,stock:i.stock,stocked:true}];return ls.filter(l=>l.stock!==0||l.stocked||l.mm===i.baseLength);}
function lenStock(i,mm){if(!i)return 0;const l=(i.lengths||[]).find(x=>x.mm===mm);return l?l.stock:(i.hasLength?0:i.stock);}
function lowLen(i,l){return !!l.stocked&&l.stock<=i.safety;}
function isLow(i){return visibleLengths(i).some(l=>lowLen(i,l));}
/* v3.7 사진: 구글 드라이브 썸네일 주소는 화면 크기에 맞는 크기(w값)로 바꿔 불러옵니다. 그 밖의 주소는 그대로 씁니다. */
function photoSrc(u,w){u=String(u||'');return /drive\.google\.com\/thumbnail\?/.test(u)?u.replace(/([?&])sz=[wsh]\d+/,'$1sz=w'+w):u;}
function photoInner(i,w){return PHOTO_ICON+(i&&i.photo?'<img src="'+esc(photoSrc(i.photo,w||500))+'" alt="" loading="lazy" referrerpolicy="no-referrer" onerror="photoErr(this)">':'');}
function photoErr(img){if(!img.dataset.r){img.dataset.r='1';setTimeout(()=>{try{img.src=img.src.replace(/[&?]r=\d+$/,'')+(img.src.includes('?')?'&':'?')+'r='+Date.now();}catch(e){}},1200);}else img.remove();}
function lenCells(i,limit){
  const ls=visibleLengths(i),u=esc(unitOf(i)),open=expanded.has(i.code);
  const shown=(!limit||open||ls.length<=limit+1)?ls:ls.slice(0,limit);
  let h=shown.map(l=>'<span class="lc'+(lowLen(i,l)?' low':'')+(l.stock===0?' zero':'')+'"><small>'+esc(i.hasLength?l.mm+'mm':'현재 재고')+'</small><b>'+fmt(l.stock)+'<i>'+u+'</i></b></span>').join('');
  if(shown.length<ls.length)h+='<span class="lc more" data-more="'+esc(i.code)+'" role="button">+'+(ls.length-shown.length)+'<small>더 보기</small></span>';
  else if(open&&limit&&ls.length>limit+1)h+='<span class="lc more" data-more="'+esc(i.code)+'" role="button">접기</span>';
  return h;
}
function lenSummary(i){return i.hasLength?visibleLengths(i).filter(l=>l.stock>0).map(l=>l.mm+'mm '+fmt(l.stock)).join(' / '):'';}
function stockCard(i){
  const multi=i.hasLength&&visibleLengths(i).length>1;
  const foot=[multi?'총 '+fmt(i.stock)+unitOf(i):'',i.location||'위치 미등록'].filter(Boolean).join(' · ');
  return '<button class="scard'+(isLow(i)?' is-low':'')+'" data-code="'+esc(i.code)+'"><span class="sc-photo">'+photoInner(i)+'</span><span class="sc-body">'+
    (i.orderCode?'<span class="sc-m">'+esc(i.orderCode)+'</span>':'')+
    '<span class="kv"><em>품목명</em><b>'+esc(i.name)+'</b>'+categoryBadge(i)+'</span>'+
    '<span class="kv"><em>코드</em><span>'+esc(i.code)+'</span></span>'+
    (i.size?'<span class="kv"><em>크기</em><span>'+esc(i.size)+'</span></span>':'')+
    (i.spec?'<span class="kv"><em>규격</em><span>'+esc(i.spec)+'</span></span>':'')+
    '<span class="lc-grid">'+lenCells(i,4)+'</span><span class="sc-foot">'+esc(foot)+'</span></span></button>';
}

// [v2.6 변경 A/C] 분류와 표시 단위. 수량 단위는 EA로 표시(기존 본은 화면에서만 EA).
const CATEGORIES=['원장','기타 자재','확인 필요'];

let accessToken='',accessActor='';
function authSaved(value){
  const key='achicell-company-auth';
  if(value===undefined){try{const raw=localStorage.getItem(key)||sessionStorage.getItem(key);return raw?JSON.parse(raw):null;}catch(e){try{return JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem(key)||'null');}catch(ignore){return null;}}}
  if(value===null){try{localStorage.removeItem(key);}catch(e){}try{sessionStorage.removeItem(key);}catch(e){}return null;}
  try{localStorage.setItem(key,JSON.stringify(value));try{sessionStorage.removeItem(key);}catch(e){}return null;}catch(e){}
  try{sessionStorage.setItem(key,JSON.stringify(value));}catch(e){}
  msg('이 브라우저는 자동 접속 저장을 제한합니다. 다음 접속 때 다시 인증이 필요할 수 있습니다.',true);return null;
}
function showCompanyLogin(message){uiHideDialogs();document.body.classList.remove('company-ready');el('company-login').classList.remove('hidden');el('login-error').textContent=message||'';}
function useCompanyAuth(a){accessToken=a.token;accessActor=a.actor;authSaved(a);el('company-password').value='';el('company-login').classList.add('hidden');document.body.classList.add('company-ready');load(false);}
function logoutCompany(){if(!confirm('작업자를 바꾸거나 나가면, 다음 접속 때 이름과 회사 비밀번호를 다시 입력해야 합니다.\n나갈까요?'))return;if(busy){msg('저장 응답을 기다린 후 다시 시도하세요.',true);return;}accessToken='';accessActor='';authSaved(null);db=null;sel='';lastTx=null;showCompanyLogin(pending?'미확인 요청을 보존했습니다. 원래 작업자로 접속해 결과를 확인하세요.':'');}
function companyFailure(error){const t=error?.message||String(error);if(t.includes('접속 만료:')){showCompanyLogin('접속이 만료되었습니다. 같은 이름과 접속 구분으로 다시 접속하세요.');return true;}return false;}
function loginCompanySubmit(event){
  event.preventDefault();const button=el('company-enter');button.disabled=true;button.textContent='확인 중…';el('login-error').textContent='';
  const saved=authSaved();
  google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(a=>{button.disabled=false;button.textContent='접속하기';useCompanyAuth(a);}).withFailureHandler(e=>{button.disabled=false;button.textContent='접속하기';el('company-password').value='';el('login-error').textContent=e.message||String(e);}).loginCompany({name:el('company-name').value,password:el('company-password').value,role:el('company-role').value,previousToken:pending?.authToken||saved?.token||accessToken});
}

function unitOf(item){const unit=String(item?.unit||'EA').trim();return unit.toUpperCase()==='EA'||unit==='본'?'EA':unit;}
function unitForCode(code){return unitOf(db?.items.find(i=>i.code===code));}
function categoryOf(item){return item?.category||'원장';}
function categoryBadge(item){return '<span class="category-badge">'+esc(categoryOf(item))+'</span>';}
function totalsByUnit(items){const totals=new Map();items.forEach(i=>{const u=unitOf(i);totals.set(u,(totals.get(u)||0)+i.stock);});return Array.from(totals,([unit,n])=>fmt(n)+' '+unit).join(' · ')||'0 EA';}

function msg(t,error){el('global').textContent=t||'';el('global').className='message'+(error?' error':'')+(t?'':' hidden');}
function session(value){try{if(value===undefined)return JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('achicell-v2-pending')||'null');if(value===null)sessionStorage.removeItem('achicell-v2-pending');else sessionStorage.setItem('achicell-v2-pending',JSON.stringify(value));}catch(e){if(value)msg('이 브라우저는 요청 복구 저장을 지원하지 않습니다. 저장 결과 확인 전에는 창을 닫지 마세요.',true);}return null;}
function vibrate(p){try{if(navigator.vibrate)navigator.vibrate(p);}catch(e){}}
function frozen(){return !db||busy||!!pending;}
function current(){return db&&sel?db.items.find(i=>i.code===sel&&i.active):null;}
function show(v){if(v==='manage'&&(!db||!db.user.admin))return;view=v;document.body.classList.toggle('work-mode',v==='work');document.querySelectorAll('main>section').forEach(s=>s.classList.toggle('hidden',s.id!=='view-'+v));document.querySelectorAll('[data-view]').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('active',b.dataset.view===v));if(v==='labels')renderLabels();const titles={work:['현장 입출고','스캔하고, 수량만 누르세요.'],stock:['재고 현황','전체 수량과 품목별 재고를 확인하세요.'],manage:['품목 관리 · 재고 실사','기준을 정리하고 실제 수량과 맞춥니다.'],labels:['보관대 QR 라벨','자재 하나에 라벨 하나. 현장에서는 수량만 선택하세요.'],history:['입출고 기록','최근 100건']};el('page-title').textContent=titles[v][0];el('page-subtitle').textContent=titles[v][1];}

/* ---------- 작업 화면 ---------- */
// [v2.6 변경 C] 선택 자재의 단위로 수량 버튼 구성.
function buildLanes(){const unit=esc(unitOf(current()));[['out-qty','출고'],['in-qty','입고']].forEach(([id,type])=>{el(id).innerHTML=QTY.map(n=>'<button type="button" data-type="'+type+'" data-n="'+n+'" aria-label="'+type+' '+n+unit+'">'+n+'<small>'+unit+'</small></button>').join('');});document.querySelectorAll('[data-type]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>commit(b.dataset.type,Number(b.dataset.n),''));}
function markLane(action){chosenType='';el('lane-out').classList.remove('focus');el('lane-in').classList.remove('focus');}

function chooseOperation(type){const i=current();if(!i||frozen()||cooldown||!['입고','출고','절단'].includes(type))return;if(type==='절단'&&!i.hasLength)return;chosenType=type;chosenLen=i.hasLength?null:0;closeDirect();if(type==='절단')setupCut();renderWork();}
function resetOperation(){if(frozen()||cooldown)return;chosenType='';chosenLen=null;closeDirect();renderWork();}
/* v3.0 길이 고르기 */
function lenCandidates(i){const ls=visibleLengths(i);return chosenType==='출고'?ls.filter(l=>l.stock>0):ls;}
function renderLenPanel(i,off){
  const c=lenCandidates(i),u=esc(unitOf(i));
  el('len-title').textContent=chosenType==='출고'?'어떤 길이를 꺼내나요?':'어떤 길이를 넣나요?';
  let h=c.map(l=>'<button type="button" class="len-chip'+(l.mm===chosenLen?' on':'')+'" data-len="'+l.mm+'"><b>'+l.mm+'mm</b><small>지금 '+fmt(l.stock)+u+'</small></button>').join('');
  if(chosenLen&&!c.some(l=>l.mm===chosenLen))h+='<button type="button" class="len-chip on" data-len="'+chosenLen+'"><b>'+chosenLen+'mm</b><small>새 길이</small></button>';
  el('len-chips').innerHTML=h||'<p class="muted">꺼낼 수 있는 길이가 없습니다.</p>';
  el('len-chips').querySelectorAll('[data-len]').forEach(b=>{b.disabled=off;b.onclick=()=>{chosenLen=Number(b.dataset.len);closeDirect();renderWork();};});
  el('len-new').classList.toggle('hidden',chosenType!=='입고');
}
function useNewLen(){if(frozen()||cooldown||chosenType!=='입고')return;const v=Number(el('len-new-input').value);if(!Number.isSafeInteger(v)||v<1||v>100000){msg('새 길이는 1~100000 사이 숫자(mm)로 입력하세요.',true);return;}msg('');chosenLen=v;el('len-new-input').value='';closeDirect();renderWork();}
/* v3.0 절단 */
function setupCut(){const i=current();if(!i)return;const opts=visibleLengths(i).filter(l=>l.stock>0);el('cut-from').innerHTML=opts.map(l=>'<option value="'+l.mm+'">'+l.mm+'mm · 지금 '+fmt(l.stock)+esc(unitOf(i))+'</option>').join('')||'<option value="">자를 수 있는 재고가 없습니다</option>';el('cut-count').value=1;el('cut-memo').value='';el('cut-rows').innerHTML='';addCutRow();addCutRow();}
function addCutRow(){if(el('cut-rows').children.length>=8)return;el('cut-rows').insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend','<div class="cut-row"><input class="cut-len" type="number" inputmode="numeric" min="1" max="100000" step="1" placeholder="길이" oninput="updateCut()"><span>mm ×</span><input class="cut-qty" type="number" inputmode="numeric" min="1" max="1000000" step="1" placeholder="개수" oninput="updateCut()"><button type="button" class="ghost" aria-label="이 줄 지우기" onclick="this.parentNode.remove();updateCut()">✕</button></div>');}
function readCut(){
  const i=current(),from=Number(el('cut-from').value),count=Number(el('cut-count').value),pieces=[];let bad='';
  document.querySelectorAll('#cut-rows .cut-row').forEach(r=>{const a=r.querySelector('.cut-len').value,b=r.querySelector('.cut-qty').value;if(a===''&&b==='')return;const L=Number(a),q=Number(b);
    if(!Number.isSafeInteger(L)||L<1||!Number.isSafeInteger(q)||q<1)bad=bad||'잘린 길이와 개수를 모두 숫자로 입력하세요.';else if(L>=from)bad=bad||'잘린 길이는 원래 길이('+from+'mm)보다 짧아야 합니다.';else pieces.push({length:L,qty:q});});
  if(!i||!from)bad=bad||'자를 원래 길이를 고르세요.';
  else if(!Number.isSafeInteger(count)||count<1)bad=bad||'자른 개수를 1 이상으로 입력하세요.';
  else if(count>lenStock(i,from))bad=bad||from+'mm 재고('+fmt(lenStock(i,from))+unitOf(i)+')보다 많이 자를 수 없습니다.';
  if(!bad&&!pieces.length)bad='잘라서 나온 길이를 한 줄 이상 입력하세요.';
  const used=pieces.reduce((a,p)=>a+p.length*p.qty,0);
  if(!bad&&used>from*count)bad='잘린 길이의 합('+fmt(used)+'mm)이 원래 자재('+fmt(from*count)+'mm)보다 깁니다.';
  return {from:from,count:count,pieces:pieces,used:used,bad:bad};
}
function updateCut(){const c=readCut(),u=unitOf(current());el('cut-preview').className=c.bad?'low':'muted';
  el('cut-preview').textContent=c.bad||(c.from+'mm '+fmt(c.count)+u+' 출고 → '+c.pieces.map(p=>p.length+'mm '+fmt(p.qty)+u).join(', ')+' 입고'+(c.from*c.count-c.used>0?' · 적지 않은 자투리 약 '+fmt(c.from*c.count-c.used)+'mm':''));
  el('cut-save').disabled=!!c.bad||frozen()||cooldown;}
function submitCut(){const i=current(),c=readCut();if(!i||frozen()||cooldown||chosenType!=='절단')return;if(c.bad){msg(c.bad,true);return;}
  const u=unitOf(i),wd=wdValue(),scrap=c.from*c.count-c.used,memo=el('cut-memo').value;
  askBox({tone:'cut',badge:'절단',kicker:'저장 전 확인',title:i.name,sub:[i.orderCode,i.code,i.size].filter(Boolean).join(' · '),
    qty:{label:fmt(c.from)+' mm 출고',value:'−'+fmt(c.count),unit:u},
    rows:[['잘라서 입고',c.pieces.map(p=>fmt(p.length)+'mm '+fmt(p.qty)+u).join(', ')]].concat(scrap>0?[['남는 길이','약 '+fmt(scrap)+'mm (기록 안 됨)']]:[]).concat(wdRows(wd)).concat(memo.trim()?[['메모',memo.trim()]]:[]),
    yes:'절단 기록',no:'취소'}).then(ok=>{
    if(!ok||frozen()||busy||pending)return;
    msg('');resetUndo();const pl={code:i.code,fromLength:c.from,count:c.count,pieces:c.pieces,memo:memo};if(wd)pl.workDate=wd;begin('cutStock',pl);
  });}
// [v2.6 변경] 분류/품목별 단위 반영.
function renderWork(){
  const i=current();document.body.classList.toggle('has-item',!!i);buildLanes();el('quantity-unit').textContent=unitOf(i);el('balance-unit').textContent=unitOf(i);el('selected-category').textContent=categoryOf(i);
  if(i){
    el('selected-code').textContent=i.code;el('selected-name').textContent=i.name;
    el('selected-order').textContent=i.orderCode||'';el('selected-order').classList.toggle('hidden',!i.orderCode);
    el('selected-size').textContent=i.size||'';el('selected-size-row').classList.toggle('hidden',!i.size);
    uiHTML(el('selected-photo'),photoInner(i));
    el('selected-detail').textContent=[i.spec,i.location||'위치 미등록'].filter(Boolean).join(' · ');
    el('selected-lens').innerHTML=i.hasLength?lenCells(i,0):'';el('selected-lens').classList.toggle('hidden',!i.hasLength);
    el('balance-label').textContent=i.hasLength?'총 재고':'현재 재고';el('balance').textContent=fmt(i.stock);
    const lows=visibleLengths(i).filter(l=>lowLen(i,l));
    el('selected-low').textContent=lows.length?'⚠ 부족 · '+(i.hasLength?lows.map(l=>l.mm+'mm '+fmt(l.stock)+unitOf(i)).join(', ')+' · ':'')+'알림 기준 '+fmt(i.safety)+unitOf(i)+' 이하':'';
    el('item-card').classList.toggle('is-low',lows.length>0);
  }
  const off=frozen()||cooldown||!i;
  const isMove=chosenType==='입고'||chosenType==='출고';
  if(i&&!i.hasLength)chosenLen=0;
  const needLen=!!i&&i.hasLength&&isMove;
  if(needLen&&chosenLen===null){const c=lenCandidates(i);if(c.length===1)chosenLen=c[0].mm;}
  const lenMissing=needLen&&!chosenLen;
  el('len-panel').classList.toggle('hidden',!needLen);if(needLen)renderLenPanel(i,off);
  el('operation-choice').classList.toggle('hidden',!i||!!chosenType);
  el('choose-cut').classList.toggle('hidden',!i||!i.hasLength);
  el('operation-toolbar').classList.toggle('hidden',!i||!chosenType);
  el('operation-selected').textContent=chosenType==='절단'?'✂ 절단 기록':chosenType+(needLen&&chosenLen?' · '+chosenLen+'mm':'')+(lenMissing?' · 길이를 먼저 고르세요':' 수량을 선택하세요');
  el('lane-out').classList.toggle('hidden',!i||chosenType!=='출고'||lenMissing);
  el('lane-in').classList.toggle('hidden',!i||chosenType!=='입고'||lenMissing);
  el('cut-panel').classList.toggle('hidden',!i||chosenType!=='절단');
  el('choose-out').disabled=off;el('choose-in').disabled=off;el('choose-cut').disabled=off;el('change-operation').disabled=off;
  const avail=i?lenStock(i,chosenLen||0):0;
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-type]').forEach(b=>{b.disabled=off||lenMissing||(b.dataset.type==='출고'&&Number(b.dataset.n)>avail);});
  el('out-direct').disabled=off||lenMissing||avail<1;el('in-direct').disabled=off||lenMissing;
  if(directType)updateDirect();
  if(chosenType==='절단')updateCut();
  renderResult();
  renderSheet();
}
// [v2.6 변경] 분류/품목별 단위 반영.
function renderResult(){
  const box=el('result');
  if(busy&&pending&&pending.method!=='adjustStock'){box.className='result saving';el('result-main').textContent='저장 중…';el('result-sub').textContent='잠시만 기다려 주세요';el('undo').classList.add('hidden');return;}
  if(!result){box.className='result hidden';return;}
  const k=result.kind,u=unitOf(result),L=result.length?result.length+'mm ':'';box.className='result '+(k==='출고'?'out':k==='입고'?'in':k==='절단'?'cut':'cancel');
  el('result-main').textContent=k==='취소'?'↺ 되돌리기 완료':k==='절단'?'✓ 절단 기록 완료'+(result.dup?' (이미 저장됨)':''):'✓ '+k+' '+L+fmt(result.quantity)+u+' 완료'+(result.dup?' (이미 저장됨)':'');
  el('result-sub').textContent=k==='절단'
    ?result.name+' · '+L+fmt(result.quantity)+u+' → '+(result.pieces||[]).map(p=>p.length+'mm '+fmt(p.qty)+u).join(', ')+' · 총 재고 '+fmt(result.stock)+u
    :result.name+(result.length&&Number.isSafeInteger(result.lengthStock)?' · '+L+'남은 '+fmt(result.lengthStock)+u:'')+' · 총 재고 '+fmt(result.stock)+u;
  el('undo').classList.toggle('hidden',!(lastTx&&k!=='취소'&&lastTx.id===result.id));el('undo').disabled=frozen();
}
// [v2.6 변경 F] 출고 5 이상 또는 직접 출고는 최종 확인. 입고는 바로 저장.
function commit(type,n,memo,fromDirect=false){
  const i=current();if(!i||frozen()||cooldown||chosenType!==type||!['입고','출고'].includes(type))return;
  const len=i.hasLength?chosenLen:0;if(i.hasLength&&!len){msg('길이를 먼저 고르세요.',true);return;}
  const avail=lenStock(i,len),L=len?len+'mm ':'';
  if(!Number.isSafeInteger(n)||n<1||n>1000000){msg('수량은 1 이상의 정수로 입력하세요.',true);return;}
  if(type==='출고'&&n>avail){msg(L+'현재 재고('+fmt(avail)+unitOf(i)+')보다 많이 출고할 수 없습니다.\n실제 개수가 다르면 관리자에게 실사 조정을 요청하세요.',true);return;}
  // v3.11: 입고·출고 모두 저장 직전에 한 번 확인합니다(클릭 실수 방지). 수량 크기와 상관없이 항상 묻습니다.
  // v3.12: 브라우저 기본 확인창 대신 앱 확인 창. 작업일이 오늘이 아니면 눈에 띄게 표시합니다.
  const after=type==='출고'?avail-n:avail+n,u=unitOf(i),wd=wdValue();
  // v3.13: 처음 들어오는 길이는 구분(원장·컷팅·잔재)을 골라야 저장됩니다.
  const isNewLen=!!(len&&!(i.lengths||[]).some(l=>l.mm===len)),lkNow=isNewLen?(typeof lkPick!=='undefined'&&lkPick.len===len?lkPick.kind:''):lkOf(i,len);
  if(type==='입고'&&isNewLen&&!lkNow){msg(fmt(len)+'mm는 처음 들어오는 길이입니다. 원장 · 컷팅 · 잔재 중 하나를 고르세요.',true);const b=el('qs-lkind');if(b)b.scrollIntoView({block:'center',behavior:'smooth'});return;}
  askBox({tone:type==='출고'?'out':'in',badge:type,kicker:'저장 전 확인',title:i.name,sub:[i.orderCode,i.code,i.size].filter(Boolean).join(' · '),
    qty:{label:len?fmt(len)+' mm'+(lkNow?' · '+lkNow:''):'수량',value:(type==='출고'?'−':'+')+fmt(n),unit:u},
    flow:{from:fmt(avail),to:fmt(after),unit:u,label:len?fmt(len)+'mm 재고':'재고'},
    rows:wdRows(wd).concat(memo&&memo.trim()?[['메모',memo.trim()]]:[]),
    yes:type+' 확정',no:'취소'}).then(ok=>{
    if(!ok||frozen()||busy||pending)return;
    msg('');resetUndo();const pl={code:i.code,type:type,quantity:n,memo:memo||'',length:len||''};if(wd)pl.workDate=wd;if(type==='입고'&&isNewLen&&lkNow)pl.lengthKind=lkNow;begin('saveTransaction',pl);
  });
}
function startCooldown(){cooldown=true;renderWork();setTimeout(()=>{cooldown=false;renderWork();},1200);}
function undoLast(){
  if(!lastTx||frozen())return;
  if(!undoArmed){undoArmed=true;el('undo').textContent='한 번 더 누르면 취소';el('undo').classList.add('armed');clearTimeout(undoTimer);undoTimer=setTimeout(resetUndo,4000);return;}
  const target=lastTx.id;resetUndo();begin('cancelTransaction',{target:target,reason:'작업 직후 되돌리기'});
}
function resetUndo(){undoArmed=false;clearTimeout(undoTimer);el('undo').textContent='되돌리기';el('undo').classList.remove('armed');if(sheetOpen)renderSheet();}
function openDirect(type){const ci=current();if(!ci||frozen()||cooldown||chosenType!==type||(ci.hasLength&&!chosenLen))return;directType=type;el('custom-panel').classList.remove('hidden');el('custom-panel').classList.toggle('outbound',type==='출고');el('custom-title').textContent=type+(chosenLen?' '+chosenLen+'mm':'')+' 수량 직접 입력';el('quantity').value='';el('memo').value='';updateDirect();el('custom-panel').scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'center'});el('quantity').focus();}
function closeDirect(){directType='';el('custom-panel').classList.add('hidden');}
function updateDirect(){const i=current(),q=Number(el('quantity').value),ok=!!i&&!!directType&&el('quantity').value!==''&&Number.isSafeInteger(q)&&q>0;const len=i&&i.hasLength?chosenLen||0:0,avail=lenStock(i,len),L=len?len+'mm ':'';const over=ok&&directType==='출고'&&q>avail;el('next-balance').textContent=over?L+'현재 재고보다 많습니다.':ok?'처리 후 '+L+'예상 재고 '+fmt(avail+(directType==='출고'?-q:q))+unitOf(i):'';el('next-balance').className=over?'low':'muted';el('custom-save').textContent=directType+' '+(ok?fmt(q)+unitOf(i)+' ':'')+'저장';el('custom-save').disabled=!ok||over||frozen()||cooldown;}
function submitDirect(){if(!directType)return;const q=Number(el('quantity').value);if(el('quantity').value===''){el('quantity').focus();return;}commit(directType,q,el('memo').value,true);}

/* ---------- 자재 찾기 ---------- */
function parseCode(text){text=String(text||'').trim();if(/^https?:\/\//i.test(text)){try{const u=new URL(text);return {code:(u.searchParams.get('sku')||'').trim().toUpperCase(),action:u.searchParams.get('action')||'',url:true};}catch(e){return {code:'',action:'',url:true};}}return {code:text.toUpperCase(),action:'',url:false};}
function canonicalCode(code){const normalized=String(code||'').replace(/\s+/g,'').toUpperCase();return db?.aliases?.[normalized]||normalized;}
function matches(q){const active=db.items.filter(i=>i.active);if(!q)return active;const words=q.toLowerCase().split(/\s+/);return active.filter(i=>words.every(w=>[i.code,i.name,i.spec,i.location,i.size,i.orderCode,...(i.lengths||[]).filter(l=>l.mm).map(l=>l.mm+'mm'),...Object.keys(db.aliases||{}).filter(old=>db.aliases[old]===i.code)].join(' ').toLowerCase().includes(w)));}
// [v2.6 변경] 분류/품목별 단위 반영.
function renderFind(){
  if(!db)return;const raw=el('find').value.trim(),list=el('find-list');
  if(/^https?:/i.test(raw)){list.innerHTML='';return;}
  const items=matches(raw),shown=items.slice(0,30);
  list.innerHTML=shown.map(i=>'<button class="listitem'+(i.code===sel?' current':'')+'" data-pick="'+esc(i.code)+'"><span><b>'+esc(i.name)+'</b><small>'+esc([i.orderCode,i.code,i.size,lenSummary(i)||i.spec,i.location].filter(Boolean).join(' · '))+'</small></span><span class="'+(isLow(i)?'low':'')+'">'+fmt(i.stock)+esc(unitOf(i))+'</span></button>').join('')||'<p class="muted">찾는 자재가 없습니다.</p>';
  if(items.length>30)list.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend','<p class="muted">외 '+(items.length-30)+'품목 · 검색어를 더 입력하세요.</p>');
  list.querySelectorAll('[data-pick]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>pick(b.dataset.pick,''));
}
function findEnter(){if(!db)return;const raw=el('find').value,p=parseCode(raw);let item=db.items.find(i=>i.active&&i.code===canonicalCode(p.code));if(!item&&!p.url){const m=matches(raw.trim());if(m.length===1)item=m[0];}if(item)pick(item.code,p.action);else msg(p.url||!raw.trim()?'사용 가능한 품목이 아닙니다: '+(p.code||'코드 없음'):'여러 개가 검색됐습니다. 목록에서 골라주세요.',true);}
function pick(code,action){openSheet(code,null);}
function focusFind(){document.body.classList.add('finder-open');el('finder').scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'start'});setTimeout(()=>el('find').focus(),300);renderFind();}

/* ---------- 데이터 ---------- */
function selectOptions(id,items,empty){const old=el(id).value;el(id).innerHTML=(empty!==null?'<option value="">'+esc(empty)+'</option>':'')+items.map(i=>'<option value="'+esc(i.code)+'">'+esc(i.code+' · '+i.name+(i.active?'':' [중지]'))+'</option>').join('');if(items.some(i=>i.code===old))el(id).value=old;}
// [v2.6 변경] 분류/품목별 단위 반영.
function render(){
  const qrOpen=!!initialSku; // v3.11: QR로 처음 열린 경우, 입출고 창을 먼저 그리고 무거운 목록은 그 다음에 그립니다.
  const active=db.items.filter(i=>i.active);
  el('identity').textContent=db.user.name==='관리자'?'관리자':db.user.name+' · '+(db.user.admin?'관리자':'작업자');
  document.querySelectorAll('.admin-only').forEach(n=>n.classList.toggle('hidden',!db.user.admin));
  selectOptions('audit-sku',active,'품목을 선택하세요');selectOptions('edit-sku',db.items,'새 품목 등록');selectOptions('label-sku',active,'사용 중인 품목 전체');
  if(requestedEditCode&&db.items.some(i=>i.code===requestedEditCode)){el('edit-sku').value=requestedEditCode;requestedEditCode='';formsReady=false;}
  if(initialSku){const i=active.find(x=>x.code===canonicalCode(initialSku));if(i){show('stock');openSheet(i.code,null);}else msg('QR 품목을 사용할 수 없습니다: '+initialSku,true);initialSku='';initialAction='';}
  if(sel&&!current())sel='';
  renderWork();renderFind();
  el('shortages').innerHTML=active.filter(isLow).map(i=>'<button class="listitem" data-code="'+esc(i.code)+'"><span>'+esc(i.name)+'<small>'+esc([i.code,i.size].filter(Boolean).join(' · '))+'</small></span><b class="low">'+esc(visibleLengths(i).filter(l=>lowLen(i,l)).map(l=>(i.hasLength?l.mm+'mm ':'')+fmt(l.stock)+unitOf(i)).join(' · '))+'</b></button>').join('')||'<p class="muted">부족 알림 기준 이하인 품목이 없습니다.</p>';
  el('shortages').querySelectorAll('[data-code]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>pick(b.dataset.code,''));
  const heavy=()=>{if(!db)return;renderOperations();renderStock();renderHistory();if(view==='labels')renderLabels();};
  if(qrOpen)requestAnimationFrame(()=>setTimeout(heavy,80));else heavy();
  if(!formsReady){formsReady=true;auditChanged();editChanged();}else if(!auditSnapshot||auditSnapshot.code!==el('audit-sku').value)auditChanged();
}
function controls(){
  const f=frozen();['audit-fields','item-fields'].forEach(id=>el(id).disabled=f||!(db&&db.user.admin));
  el('reload').disabled=busy||loading;el('retry').disabled=busy;el('retry').textContent=busy?'확인 중…':'같은 요청 재시도';
  el('pending-box').classList.toggle('hidden',!pending||busy);
  if(pending)el('pending-summary').textContent=pending.method+' · '+(pending.payload.code||pending.payload.target)+' · '+(pending.payload.type||'')+' '+(pending.payload.quantity??pending.payload.count??'기록 취소');
  renderWork();renderPv();
}
function load(quiet){
  if(!accessToken)return;
  if(loading&&!quiet)return;const seq=++loadSeq;
  if(!quiet){loading=true;el('sync').textContent='서버 재고 확인 중…';controls();}
  google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(r=>{
    if(!quiet)loading=false;
    if(seq<minSeq||seq<appliedSeq||busy||pending){controls();return;}
    db=r;appliedSeq=seq;el('sync').textContent='조회 '+r.timestamp;render();controls();if(r.warnings&&r.warnings.length)msg(r.warnings.join('\n'),true);
  }).withFailureHandler(e=>{
    if(!quiet)loading=false;if(companyFailure(e))return;el('sync').textContent='갱신 실패 · 표시 수량은 이전 조회 기준';
    if(!quiet||!db)msg(e.message||String(e),true);controls();
  }).getDashboard(accessToken);
}
function begin(method,payload){if(frozen())return;toast('처리 중…','busy');payload.requestId='ac_'+Date.now()+'_'+(globalThis.crypto?.randomUUID?crypto.randomUUID().replace(/-/g,''):Math.random().toString(36).slice(2));pending={method:method,payload:payload,actor:accessActor,authToken:accessToken};session(pending);sendPending();}
// [v2.6 변경] 분류/품목별 단위 반영.
function sendPending(){
  if(!pending||busy)return;if(pending.actor!==accessActor){msg('이전 작업자의 미확인 요청입니다. 원래 작업자로 다시 접속하세요. 이전 버전 요청이면 관리자가 기록을 확인한 후 이 탭을 닫고 새 탭으로 접속하세요.',true);return;}busy=true;controls();const p=pending;
  google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(packet=>{
    const r=packet.result;busy=false;pending=null;session(null);uiInvalidateReads();const fresh=uiAcceptSnapshot(packet.dashboard);doneToast(p.method,r);
    const item=db&&db.items.find(x=>x.code===r.code);
    if(!fresh&&item&&Number.isSafeInteger(r.currentStock))item.stock=r.currentStock;
    if(!fresh&&item&&Array.isArray(r.lengths))item.lengths=r.lengths;
    if(p.method==='saveTransaction'){
      lastTx={id:p.payload.requestId,code:r.code};
      result={id:p.payload.requestId,kind:r.type,quantity:r.quantity,length:r.length||0,lengthStock:r.lengthStock,name:item?item.name:r.code,stock:r.currentStock,unit:item?.unit||'EA',dup:r.duplicate};
      closeDirect();vibrate(40);startCooldown();
    }else if(p.method==='cutStock'){
      lastTx={id:p.payload.requestId,code:r.code};
      result={id:p.payload.requestId,kind:'절단',quantity:r.quantity,length:r.length||p.payload.fromLength,pieces:r.pieces||p.payload.pieces,name:item?item.name:r.code,stock:r.currentStock,unit:item?.unit||'EA',dup:r.duplicate};
      setupCut();vibrate(40);startCooldown();
    }else if(p.method==='cancelTransaction'){
      if(lastTx&&lastTx.id===p.payload.target)lastTx=null;
      result={id:'',kind:'취소',quantity:r.quantity,name:item?item.name:r.code,stock:r.currentStock,unit:item?.unit||'EA'};
      vibrate([30,40,30]);if(view!=='work')msg('기록 취소 완료 · '+r.code+' 현재 '+fmt(r.currentStock)+unitOf(item));
    }else{
      msg('실사 조정 완료 · '+r.code+' 현재 '+fmt(r.currentStock)+unitOf(item));el('count').value='';el('audit-reason').value='';auditSnapshot=null;
    }
    render();controls();uiPulse(r.code);if(!fresh)uiRefreshAfterSave();
  }).withFailureHandler(e=>{
    busy=false;if(companyFailure(e)){toastHide();controls();return;}const t=e.message||String(e);toast(t.includes('[확인]')?t.replace(/^Error: /,'').replace('[확인] ',''):'응답을 확인하지 못했어요. 아래 \'같은 요청 재시도\'를 눌러주세요.','err');
    if(t.includes('[확인]')){pending=null;session(null);msg(t.replace('Error: ',''),true);vibrate([80,60,80]);load(true);}
    else msg('응답을 확인하지 못했습니다. 아래 ‘같은 요청 재시도’로 결과를 확인하세요.\n'+t,true);
    controls();
  }).uiMutate(p.method,p.payload,accessToken);
}

/* ---------- 재고·기록 ---------- */
// [v2.6 변경 A/C] 상태 필터와 분류 필터를 함께 적용.
function renderStock(){
  if(!db)return;const q=el('search').value.trim(),active=db.items.filter(i=>i.active);
  const counts={all:active.length,len:active.filter(i=>i.hasLength).length,part:active.filter(i=>!i.hasLength).length,low:active.filter(isLow).length};
  const names=[['all','전체'],['len','프로파일'],['part','부속품'],['low','부족']];
  el('stock-chips').innerHTML=names.filter(([k])=>k==='all'||k==='low'||counts[k]).map(([k,t])=>'<button type="button" class="chip'+(k==='low'?' warn':'')+(stockMode===k?' on':'')+'" data-mode="'+k+'">'+t+'<b>'+counts[k]+'</b></button>').join('');
  el('stock-chips').querySelectorAll('[data-mode]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{stockMode=b.dataset.mode;renderStock();});
  const list=matches(q).filter(i=>stockMode==='all'||(stockMode==='len'&&i.hasLength)||(stockMode==='part'&&!i.hasLength)||(stockMode==='low'&&isLow(i)));
  uiStockRows(list);uiOverview();
  el('stock-list').onclick=ev=>{const c=ev.target.closest('[data-len]');if(c){openSheet(c.dataset.code,Number(c.dataset.len)||null);return;}const r=ev.target.closest('[data-code]');if(!r)return;
    // 사진을 누르면 크게 보기·바꾸기(관리자, 또는 사진이 있을 때). 그 밖의 곳을 누르면 입출고 창.
    if(ev.target.closest('.sc-photo')){const it=db.items.find(x=>x.code===r.dataset.code);if(it&&(db.user.admin||it.photo)){openPhoto(r.dataset.code);return;}}
    openSheet(r.dataset.code,null);};
}
// [v2.6 변경] 분류/품목별 단위 반영.
function renderHistory(){if(!db)return;const kind=el('log-type').value,q=el('log-search').value.trim().toLowerCase(),rows=db.recent.filter(r=>(!kind||r.type===kind)&&[r.code,r.name,r.operator,r.memo].join(' ').toLowerCase().includes(q));el('history').innerHTML=rows.length?'<table><thead><tr><th>시각·품목</th><th>처리</th><th>변동 / 직후</th><th>작업자·사유</th><th>취소</th></tr></thead><tbody>'+rows.map(r=>'<tr><td>'+esc(r.date)+'<br>'+esc(r.code)+(r.length?' <b>'+r.length+'mm</b>':'')+(r.currentCode&&r.currentCode!==r.code?'<br><small>현재 '+esc(r.currentCode)+'</small>':'')+'</td><td>'+esc(r.type)+(r.canceled?'<br><span class="low">취소됨</span>':'')+(r.type==='실사조정'?'<br>실제 '+fmt(r.quantity)+esc(unitOf(r)):'')+'</td><td>'+(r.delta>0?'+':'')+fmt(r.delta)+esc(unitOf(r))+' / '+fmt(r.stock)+esc(unitOf(r))+'</td><td>'+esc(r.operator)+'<br>'+esc(r.memo)+'</td><td>'+(r.canCancel?'<button data-cancel="'+esc(r.id)+'">취소</button>':'—')+'</td></tr>').join('')+'</tbody></table>':'<p class="muted">조건에 맞는 기록이 없습니다. 최근 100건만 표시합니다.</p>';el('history').querySelectorAll('[data-cancel]').forEach(b=>{b.disabled=frozen();b.onclick=()=>{if(frozen())return;const r=db.recent.find(x=>x.id===b.dataset.cancel);const reason=prompt(r.code+' '+(r.length?r.length+'mm ':'')+r.type+' '+r.quantity+unitOf(r)+(r.type==='절단출고'?' (잘라서 입고된 길이도 함께)':'')+' 기록을 취소합니다.\n취소 사유를 입력하세요.','기록 정정');if(reason&&reason.trim())begin('cancelTransaction',{target:r.id,reason:reason});};});}

/* ---------- 관리 ---------- */
// [v2.6 변경] 분류/품목별 단위 반영.
function auditChanged(){const i=db?.items.find(i=>i.code===el('audit-sku').value);el('audit-len-wrap').classList.toggle('hidden',!i||!i.hasLength);
  if(i&&i.hasLength){el('audit-len').innerHTML=visibleLengths(i).map(l=>'<option value="'+l.mm+'">'+l.mm+'mm · 화면 '+fmt(l.stock)+esc(unitOf(i))+'</option>').join('')+'<option value="new">다른 길이 직접 입력</option>';el('audit-len-new').value='';}
  auditLenChanged();el('audit-unit').textContent=unitOf(i);el('count').value='';el('audit-reason').value='';}
function auditLen(){const i=db?.items.find(x=>x.code===el('audit-sku').value);if(!i||!i.hasLength){el('audit-len-new').classList.add('hidden');return 0;}const v=el('audit-len').value;el('audit-len-new').classList.toggle('hidden',v!=='new');return v==='new'?Number(el('audit-len-new').value)||0:Number(v)||0;}
function auditLenChanged(){const i=db?.items.find(x=>x.code===el('audit-sku').value),len=auditLen();auditSnapshot=i?{code:i.code,stock:lenStock(i,len),version:i.version,length:len}:null;
  el('audit-current').textContent=!i?'품목을 선택하세요.':(i.hasLength&&!len?'길이(mm)를 입력하세요.':'화면 재고 '+(len?len+'mm ':'')+fmt(lenStock(i,len))+unitOf(i)+' · 확인 중 변동이 생기면 다시 확인합니다.');}
// [v2.6 변경] 분류/품목별 단위 반영.
function submitAudit(){if(!auditSnapshot)return;auditLenChanged();const aItem=db.items.find(x=>x.code===auditSnapshot.code);if(aItem&&aItem.hasLength&&(!Number.isSafeInteger(auditSnapshot.length)||auditSnapshot.length<1||auditSnapshot.length>100000)){msg('실사할 길이(mm)를 1~100000 사이로 입력하세요.',true);return;}const AL=auditSnapshot.length?auditSnapshot.length+'mm ':'';const count=Number(el('count').value),reason=el('audit-reason').value.trim();if(el('count').value===''||!el('count').reportValidity()||!Number.isSafeInteger(count)||!reason){msg('실제 개수와 조정 사유를 입력하세요.',true);return;}if(!confirm(auditSnapshot.code+' '+AL+'재고를 '+auditSnapshot.stock+unitForCode(auditSnapshot.code)+' → '+count+unitForCode(auditSnapshot.code)+'로 조정합니다.'))return;begin('adjustStock',{code:auditSnapshot.code,count:count,reason:reason,version:auditSnapshot.version,length:auditSnapshot.length||''});}
// [v2.6 변경] 분류/품목별 단위 반영.
function editChanged(){const i=db?.items.find(i=>i.code===el('edit-sku').value);el('code-note').classList.toggle('hidden',!i);el('item-code').value=i?.code||'';el('item-code').disabled=false;
  el('item-kind').value=i?kindOf(i):'';el('item-color').value=i?colorOf(i):'';
  el('base-wrap').classList.toggle('hidden',!!(i&&i.lengthTagged));updateNamePreview();
  el('count-wrap').classList.toggle('hidden',!i);
  el('count-list').innerHTML=i?visibleLengths(i).map(l=>'<div><label style="margin:0 0 4px;font-size:11px">'+esc(i.hasLength?l.mm+'mm':'재고')+'</label><input type="number" inputmode="numeric" min="0" max="1000000" step="1" data-count-len="'+l.mm+'" data-was="'+l.stock+'" value="'+l.stock+'" style="min-height:42px"></div>').join(''):'';el('item-spec').value=i?.spec||'';el('item-category').value=categoryOf(i);el('item-unit').value=unitOf(i);el('item-memo').value=i?.memo||'';el('item-location').value=i?.location||'';el('item-safety').value=i?.safety||0;el('item-start').value=0;el('initial-wrap').classList.toggle('hidden',!!i);el('item-active').checked=i?i.active:true;el('delete-item').classList.toggle('hidden',!i);
  el('item-size').value=i?.size||'';el('item-order').value=i?.orderCode||'';el('item-photo').value=i?.photo||'';el('item-base').value=i?.baseLength||'';
  el('item-base').disabled=!!(i&&i.lengthTagged);el('base-note').textContent=i&&i.lengthTagged?'길이별 기록이 있어 바꿀 수 없습니다.':'정하면 이 길이부터 길이별로 관리합니다.';
  el('photo-upload-wrap').classList.toggle('hidden',!i);el('item-photo-file').value='';}
// [v2.6 변경] 분류/품목별 단위 반영.
function submitItem(){if(frozen()||!db.user.admin)return;const i=db.items.find(i=>i.code===el('edit-sku').value);if(!el('item-safety').reportValidity()||(!i&&!el('item-start').reportValidity()))return;
  const kind=el('item-kind').value.trim(),color=el('item-color').value.trim();if(!kind){msg('종류를 입력하세요. 예: 프로파일',true);el('item-kind').focus();return;}
  const code=el('item-code').value.trim().replace(/\s+/g,'').toUpperCase();
  const p={code:code,kind:kind,color:color,spec:el('item-spec').value,unit:i&&el('item-unit').value.trim()===unitOf(i)?i.unit:el('item-unit').value,memo:el('item-memo').value,location:el('item-location').value,size:el('item-size').value,orderCode:el('item-order').value,photo:el('item-photo').value,baseLength:el('item-base').value,safety:el('item-safety').value,start:el('item-start').value,active:el('item-active').checked,edit:!!i,version:i?.editVersion,category:i?undefined:(el('item-base').value?'원장':'기타 자재')};
  if(!i){simple('saveItem',p);return;}
  const counts=[],changes=[];let bad='';
  document.querySelectorAll('#count-list [data-count-len]').forEach(inp=>{const v=inp.value,n=Number(v),mm=Number(inp.dataset.countLen),was=Number(inp.dataset.was);
    if(v===''||!Number.isSafeInteger(n)||n<0){bad='수량은 0 이상 숫자로 입력하세요.';return;}
    if(n!==was){counts.push({length:mm||'',count:n});changes.push((mm?mm+'mm ':'')+fmt(was)+' → '+fmt(n));}});
  if(bad){msg(bad,true);return;}
  if(code!==i.code)changes.unshift('품목코드 '+i.code+' → '+code);
  if(changes.length&&!confirm(i.name+'\n\n'+changes.join('\n')+'\n\n이대로 저장할까요?'))return;
  simple('saveItemAll',Object.assign(p,{oldCode:i.code,counts:counts,stockVersion:i.version,requestId:'ac_'+Date.now()+'_'+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,10)}));
}
function submitRenameCode(){
  if(frozen()||!db?.user.admin)return;
  const oldCode=el('edit-sku').value, item=db.items.find(i=>i.code===oldCode);
  if(!item){msg('먼저 변경할 품목을 선택하세요.',true);return;}
  const newCode=el('new-item-code').value.trim().replace(/\s+/g,'').toUpperCase();
  if(!/^[A-Z0-9][A-Z0-9_-]{1,39}$/.test(newCode)||!/[A-Z]/.test(newCode)){
    msg('새 품목코드는 영문이 포함된 2~40자(영문·숫자·-·_)로 입력하세요.',true);return;
  }
  if(newCode===oldCode){msg('변경 전후 품목코드가 같습니다.',true);return;}
  if(!confirm(item.name+'\n품목코드 변경\n'+oldCode+' → '+newCode+'\n\n기존 입출고 기록·수량은 유지됩니다. 변경하시겠습니까?'))return;
  simple('renameItemCode',{oldCode:oldCode,newCode:newCode,version:item.editVersion});
}
function uploadPhoto(){
  const f=el('item-photo-file').files&&el('item-photo-file').files[0],code=el('edit-sku').value;if(!f||!code||frozen())return;
  const url=URL.createObjectURL(f),img=new Image();msg('사진 줄이는 중…');
  img.onload=()=>{try{const r=photoEncode(img);URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    const data=r.url.split(',')[1];el('item-photo-file').value='';msg('사진 올리는 중…');simple('uploadPhoto',{code:code,data:data});}catch(e){URL.revokeObjectURL(url);msg('사진을 처리하지 못했습니다: '+e.message,true);}};
  img.onerror=()=>{URL.revokeObjectURL(url);msg('이 사진 형식은 열 수 없습니다. JPG·PNG로 다시 골라주세요.',true);};
  img.src=url;
}
function deleteItem(){const code=el('edit-sku').value;if(code&&confirm(code+'를 삭제할까요? 재고·이력이 있으면 사용 중지만 가능합니다.'))simple('deleteUnusedItem',{code:code});}
function simple(method,p){
  if(frozen())return;busy=true;controls();toast(method==='uploadPhoto'?'사진 올리는 중…':'저장 중…','busy');
  google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(packet=>{
    busy=false;uiInvalidateReads();const r=packet.result;
    if(method==='renameItemCode')requestedEditCode=r.newCode;
    else if(method==='saveItemAll'||method==='saveItem')requestedEditCode=r.code||p.code;
    const fresh=uiAcceptSnapshot(packet.dashboard);formsReady=false;render();controls();
    msg(method==='renameItemCode'?'품목코드 변경 완료 · 기존 기록 및 QR 주소 유지':'');
    toast(method==='deleteUnusedItem'?'삭제되었습니다':'저장되었습니다','ok');uiPulse(r.code||r.newCode||p.code);
    if(!fresh)uiRefreshAfterSave();
  }).withFailureHandler(e=>{busy=false;uiInvalidateReads();if(companyFailure(e)){toastHide();controls();return;}toast('저장 결과를 확인해주세요','err');msg((e.message||String(e))+'\n입력한 내용은 유지했습니다. 응답 오류라면 새로고침으로 반영 여부를 먼저 확인하세요.',true);controls();}).uiMutate(method,p,accessToken);
}

/* ---------- QR 라벨 ---------- */
function stockFilter(status){if(!db)return;stockMode=status==='low'?'low':'all';renderStock();show('stock');}
// [v2.6 변경 A/C] 분류별 합계. 서로 다른 단위는 합치지 않습니다.
function stockCategoryFilter(category){if(!db)return;stockMode='all';renderStock();show('stock');}
function renderOperations(){renderSide();const active=db.items.filter(i=>i.active);el('dashboard-metrics').innerHTML=CATEGORIES.map(category=>{const items=active.filter(i=>categoryOf(i)===category);return '<button class="metric '+(category==='원장'?'total-metric':'')+'" data-category="'+esc(category)+'"><span>'+esc(category)+'</span><strong>'+esc(totalsByUnit(items))+'</strong><span class="metric-note">'+items.length+'품목 · 사용 중인 자재 · 조회 시점</span></button>';}).join('');el('dashboard-metrics').querySelectorAll('[data-category]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>stockCategoryFilter(b.dataset.category));el('work-recent').innerHTML=db.recent.slice(0,4).map(r=>'<div class="activity-row"><span class="activity-dot '+(r.type==='출고'?'outbound':'')+'"></span><span><b>'+esc(r.code)+(r.length?' · '+r.length+'mm':'')+'</b><small>'+esc(r.date)+' · '+esc(r.operator)+'</small></span><strong class="'+(r.type==='출고'?'out-text':'')+'">'+esc(r.type)+' '+(r.delta>0?'+':'')+fmt(r.delta)+esc(unitOf(r))+'</strong></div>').join('')||'<p class="empty-state">입출고 기록이 아직 없습니다.</p>';}
