      {id:'wd',label:'실제 작업일',type:'date',value:cur,max:t,min:wdShift(t,-400),help:'바쁜 날 늦게 입력했다면 실제로 작업한 날짜로 바꿔 주세요.'}],
    validate:v=>v.wd&&v.wd>t?'작업일은 오늘 이후로 정할 수 없습니다.':'',yes:'저장',no:'닫기'})
  .then(v=>{
    if(!v||frozen())return;const memo=v.memo.trim(),p={target:r.id};let changed=false;
    if(memo!==(r.memo||'')){p.memo=memo;changed=true;}
    if(v.wd&&v.wd!==cur){p.workDate=v.wd;changed=true;}
    if(!changed){msg('바뀐 내용이 없습니다.');setTimeout(()=>msg(''),2000);return;}
    if(p.memo===undefined)p.memo=null;
    apiCall('updateLogMemo',p,{busy:'기록 저장 중…',done:'기록이 수정되었습니다',ok:()=>{const R=histRemote();if(R)histFetch(R.period,R.from,R.to,R.label,true);}});
  });
}
function histCancelRow(r){
  askBox({tone:'warn',badge:'기록 취소',kicker:'되돌릴 기록 확인',title:histTitle(r,histItem(r))+(r.length?' · '+fmt(r.length)+'mm':''),
    sub:r.type+' '+fmt(r.quantity)+unitOf(r)+' · '+(r.ymd?r.ymd+' ':'')+String(r.date).slice(6,11)+' · '+r.operator,
    text:'이 기록을 취소하면 재고가 기록 전으로 돌아갑니다. 원래 기록은 지워지지 않고 취소 기록이 함께 남습니다.'+(r.type==='절단출고'?'\n잘라서 입고된 길이도 함께 취소됩니다.':''),
    fields:[{id:'reason',label:'취소 사유',value:'기록 정정',maxlength:250}],
    validate:v=>v.reason.trim()?'':'취소 사유를 입력하세요.',yes:'기록 취소',no:'닫기'})
  .then(v=>{if(v&&!frozen())begin('cancelTransaction',{target:r.id,reason:v.reason.trim()});});
}
(function(){
  // 저장 후 대시보드가 새로 오면, 기간 조회 화면도 조용히 다시 불러옵니다.
  const baseHist=renderHistory;
  renderHistory=function(){
    const S=histState,R=histRemote();
    if(R&&db&&R.stamp!==db.timestamp&&!S.loading&&view==='history'){R.stamp=db.timestamp;histFetch(R.period,R.from,R.to,R.label,true);}
    return baseHist.apply(this,arguments);
  };
  // 요약 카드: 부족 알림 기준(안전재고)이 아직 없는 품목 수를 함께 표시
  const baseOv=uiOverview;
  uiOverview=function(){
    const r=baseOv.apply(this,arguments);
    try{const n=db.items.filter(i=>i.active&&!(i.safety>0)).length,f=document.querySelector('#ui-overview .ui-low .ov-foot');if(f&&n)f.textContent='기준 미설정 '+n+'품목 · 재고 0은 항상 표시 ›';}catch(e){}
    return r;
  };
  // 로그아웃 확인도 같은 확인 창으로
  logoutCompany=(function(base){return function(){
    askBox({tone:'neutral',badge:'나가기',kicker:'작업자 변경',title:'작업자를 바꾸거나 나갈까요?',text:'다음 접속 때 이름과 회사 비밀번호를 다시 입력해야 합니다.',yes:'나가기',no:'계속 사용'})
    .then(ok=>{if(!ok)return;const c=window.confirm;window.confirm=()=>true;try{base();}finally{window.confirm=c;}});
  };})(logoutCompany);
})();
</script>
<style>
/* ===== v3.13 길이 칸(세로형) · 길이구분 꼬리표 · 색상 그룹 제목 ===== */
.srow .srow-lens{display:flex!important;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;align-content:center}
.srow .lchip.lt{position:relative;display:flex!important;flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch;justify-content:center;gap:2px;width:104px;min-height:64px!important;padding:8px 10px 9px 13px!important;border-radius:12px!important;background:#fff!important;border:1px solid #dfe3ea!important;box-shadow:0 1px 0 #e8ebf0;text-align:left;cursor:pointer;color:#4b5563!important;transition:border-color .15s,background .15s,transform .1s}
.srow .lchip.lt:hover{border-color:#3b6ff5!important;background:#f5f8ff!important}
.srow .lchip.lt:active{transform:scale(.98)}
.srow .lchip.lt:before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;top:11px;bottom:11px;width:3px;border-radius:0 3px 3px 0;background:#d5d9e0}
.srow .lchip.lt.k-원장:before{background:#2a4f9e}.srow .lchip.lt.k-컷팅:before{background:#c2610c}.srow .lchip.lt.k-잔재:before{background:#9aa3af}
.lt-top{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:4px;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;color:#4b5563;white-space:nowrap;line-height:1.2}
.lk-tag{font-size:10px;font-weight:800;border-radius:4px;padding:1px 5px;white-space:nowrap;letter-spacing:0}
.lk-원장{background:#e8eef9;color:#2a4f9e}.lk-컷팅{background:#fff1e3;color:#9a4d0c}.lk-잔재{background:#eef0f3;color:#5b6472}
.srow .lchip.lt b{display:block;margin:0!important;font-size:24px!important;line-height:1.15;font-weight:800!important;color:#16191e!important;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.srow .lchip.lt b i{font-style:normal;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;color:#8a929e;margin-left:3px}
.srow .lchip.lt.low{border-color:#f1d9cb!important;background:#fff8f4!important}.srow .lchip.lt.low b{color:#a8512c!important}
.srow .lchip.lt.zero b{color:#b3b8bc!important}
.srow-total .st-multi{font-size:22px!important;font-weight:800!important;white-space:nowrap}
#stock-list .sc-group .sc-cnt{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-width:20px;height:20px;padding:0 7px;border-radius:999px;background:#eceef2;color:#5b6472;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;align-self:center}
@media(max-width:760px){
 .srow .srow-lens{display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:6px}
 .srow .lchip.lt{width:auto;min-height:62px!important;padding:7px 8px 8px 11px!important}
 .srow .lchip.lt .lt-top{flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;gap:2px;font-size:11.5px}
 .srow .lchip.lt b{font-size:21px!important}.srow .lchip.lt b i{display:none}
 .srow-total .st-multi{font-size:17px!important}
}
.lkc{margin:-10px 0 18px;padding:12px;border:1.5px dashed #e3b98b;border-radius:12px;background:#fffaf4}
.lkc p{margin:0 0 8px;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;color:#7c3d0a}
.lk-seg{display:inline-flex;border:1px solid #d6dbe2;border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden;background:#fff}
.lk-seg button{min-height:40px;min-width:62px;padding:0 12px;border:0;border-right:1px solid #d6dbe2;background:#fff;font:inherit;font-size:13.5px;font-weight:700;color:#4b5563;cursor:pointer}
.lk-seg button:last-child{border-right:0}
.lk-seg button.on[data-k="원장"]{background:#2a4f9e;color:#fff}.lk-seg button.on[data-k="컷팅"]{background:#c2610c;color:#fff}.lk-seg button.on[data-k="잔재"]{background:#5b6472;color:#fff}
.lkc small{display:block;margin-top:7px;font-size:11px;color:#8a929e}
.qchip .lk-tag{margin-right:4px}
.qe-lk{margin:4px 0 16px}.qe-lk .qs-label{margin-bottom:8px}
.qe-lk-row{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;padding:7px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #eef0f3;font-size:14px;font-weight:700}
.qe-lk-row .lk-seg button{min-height:36px;min-width:54px;font-size:13px}
/* ===== v3.14 PC 입출고 창 글씨·간격 키우기 (폰 화면은 그대로) =====
   - 760px보다 넓은 화면(PC·태블릿 가로)에서만 적용합니다. 폰은 위 규칙 그대로입니다. */
@media(min-width:761px){
  .qs-box{width:min(620px,100%);padding:34px 36px 38px}
  .ui-panel-kicker{font-size:12px;margin-bottom:28px}.ui-panel-kicker span{font-size:13px}
  .qs-head{gap:16px;margin-bottom:26px}
  .qs-head .sc-photo{width:96px;height:96px;flex-basis:96px;border-radius:14px}
  .qs-title small{font-size:15px;margin-bottom:7px}
  .qs-title b{font-size:26px;line-height:1.25}
  .qs-icon{width:46px;min-height:46px;font-size:18px;border-radius:12px}
  .ui-balance{padding:26px 28px;margin-bottom:26px;border-radius:18px}
  .ui-balance div>span{font-size:15px}
  .ui-balance strong{font-size:56px;margin-top:6px}
  .ui-balance strong small{font-size:18px;margin-left:8px}
  .ui-stock-state{font-size:14px;padding:8px 13px;border-radius:8px}
  .qs-wd{gap:12px;padding:12px 16px;margin-bottom:20px;font-size:16px;border-radius:12px}
  .qs-wd label{font-size:15px}.qs-wd input{min-height:44px;font-size:17px;padding:5px 12px;border-radius:10px}
  .qs-wd-note{font-size:14px}.qs-wd-reset{min-height:38px;font-size:14px;padding:3px 14px}
  .qs-label{font-size:15px;margin-bottom:11px;color:#657084}
  .qs-lens{gap:10px;margin-bottom:26px}
  .qchip{min-height:70px;padding:10px 18px;border-radius:13px;font-size:20px}
  .qchip small{font-size:14px;margin-top:5px}
  .qchip.add{font-size:16px}
  #qs-newlen{width:170px;min-height:70px;font-size:18px;border-radius:13px}
  .lk-tag{font-size:12.5px;padding:2px 7px;border-radius:5px}
  .lk-seg button{min-height:50px;min-width:80px;font-size:17px}
  .lkc small{font-size:14px;margin-top:9px}
  .qs-qty{grid-template-columns:72px 1fr 72px;gap:10px;margin-bottom:14px}
  .qs-qty button{min-height:76px;font-size:32px;border-radius:14px}
  .qs-qty input{min-height:76px;font-size:40px;border-radius:14px}
  #qs-memo{min-height:58px;font-size:17px;border-radius:12px}
  .qs-hint{font-size:15.5px;line-height:1.7;min-height:40px;margin:16px 0 20px}
  .qs-actions{gap:12px}
  .qs-btn{min-height:72px;font-size:21px;border-radius:14px}
  .qs-result{padding:16px 18px;font-size:15px;border-radius:14px;margin-top:20px}
  .qs-result button{min-height:42px;font-size:15px;padding:5px 14px}
  /* 정보 수정(✎) */
  .qe-grid{gap:18px 14px}
  .qe-grid label,#qe-counts label{font-size:14px;margin-bottom:8px}
  .qe-grid input{font-size:17px;min-height:54px}
  #qs-edit details{padding:16px 18px}#qs-edit summary{font-size:16px}#qs-edit .muted{font-size:14px}
  .qe-lk-row{font-size:17px;padding:10px 0}.qe-lk-row .lk-seg button{min-height:44px;min-width:72px;font-size:16px}
  /* 절단 */
  #qs .cut-panel{font-size:16px}#qs .cut-panel label{font-size:15px}
  #qs .cut-panel select,#qs .cut-panel input{font-size:17px;min-height:52px}
  #qs .cut-row span{font-size:15px}#qs .cut-row button{min-height:48px;font-size:16px}
}
/* 화면 높이가 낮은 노트북(세로 820px 이하)은 글씨는 유지하고 간격만 줄여 버튼이 덜 밀려 내려가게 */
@media(min-width:761px) and (max-height:820px){
  .qs-box{padding:26px 34px 28px}
  .ui-panel-kicker{margin-bottom:16px}
  .qs-head{margin-bottom:18px}.qs-head .sc-photo{width:80px;height:80px;flex-basis:80px}
  .ui-balance{padding:16px 24px;margin-bottom:18px}.ui-balance strong{font-size:48px;margin-top:2px}
  .qs-wd{margin-bottom:14px;padding:8px 14px}
  .qs-lens{margin-bottom:18px}.qchip{min-height:64px;padding:8px 16px}
  #qs-newlen{min-height:64px}
  .qs-qty{margin-bottom:10px}.qs-qty button,.qs-qty input{min-height:66px}
  .qs-hint{min-height:30px;margin:12px 0 14px}
  .qs-btn{min-height:64px}
}
</style>
<script>
/* ===== v3.13 길이구분(원장·컷팅·잔재) =====
   - 원장: 2400 원자재 그대로 / 컷팅: 생산지에서 잘라서 입고 / 잔재: 우리가 자르고 남은 것(절단 기록 시 자동)
   - 재고 카드의 길이 칸: 위에 길이·구분, 아래 수량 크게. 칸을 누르면 그 길이로 입출고 창이 열립니다.
   - 처음 들어오는 길이를 입고할 때는 구분을 골라야 저장됩니다. 정보 수정(✎)에서 길이별 구분을 바꿀 수 있습니다. */
var LK_LIST=['원장','컷팅','잔재'];
var lkPick={len:null,kind:''};
function lkOf(i,mm){const l=(i&&i.lengths||[]).find(x=>x.mm===mm);return l&&l.kind||'';}
function lkTag(k){return k?'<span class="lk-tag lk-'+esc(k)+'">'+esc(k)+'</span>':'';}
function lkSeg(cur,attr){return '<span class="lk-seg" '+attr+'>'+LK_LIST.map(k=>'<button type="button" data-k="'+k+'" class="'+(k===cur?'on':'')+'" aria-pressed="'+(k===cur)+'">'+k+'</button>').join('')+'</span>';}
stockRow=function(i){
  const ls=visibleLengths(i),u=esc(unitOf(i)),low=isLow(i);
  const title=nameOf(kindOf(i),i.size,colorOf(i))||i.name;
  const meta=['<span class="sr-code">'+esc(i.code)+'</span>',i.spec?'<span>두께 '+esc(i.spec)+'</span>':'',i.location?'<span>위치 '+esc(i.location)+'</span>':'',low?'<span class="lowtag">부족</span>':''].join('');
  const tiles=ls.map(l=>{const k=i.hasLength?l.kind||'':'';
    return '<button type="button" class="lchip lt'+(k?' k-'+esc(k):'')+(lowLen(i,l)?' low':'')+(l.stock===0?' zero':'')+'" data-code="'+esc(i.code)+'" data-len="'+l.mm+'" title="'+(i.hasLength?l.mm+'mm ':'')+'입출고">'+
      '<span class="lt-top"><span>'+(i.hasLength?fmt(l.mm)+'mm':'재고')+'</span>'+lkTag(k)+'</span><b>'+fmt(l.stock)+'<i>'+u+'</i></b></button>';}).join('');
  const multi=i.hasLength&&ls.length>1;
  return '<div class="srow" data-code="'+esc(i.code)+'" role="button" tabindex="0"><span class="sc-photo">'+photoInner(i)+'</span>'+
    '<div class="srow-info">'+(i.orderCode?'<small class="sr-mtop">'+esc(i.orderCode)+'</small>':'')+'<span class="sr-title">'+esc(title)+'</span><div class="sr-meta">'+meta+'</div></div>'+
    '<div class="srow-lens">'+tiles+'</div>'+
    '<div class="srow-total">'+(multi?'<b class="st-multi">'+ls.length+'개 길이</b><small>합계 '+fmt(i.stock)+u+'</small>':'<b>'+fmt(i.stock)+'<i>'+u+'</i></b><small>'+(i.hasLength?'길이 1개':'재고')+'</small>')+'</div></div>';
};
(function(){
  // 색상 그룹 제목: "블랙 특수색 · 1품목" → "블랙 ①" 처럼 짧게
  const baseRows=uiStockRows;
  uiStockRows=function(){const r=baseRows.apply(this,arguments);
    document.querySelectorAll('#stock-list .sc-group span:not(.sc-cnt)').forEach(sp=>{const m=/(\d+)\s*품목/.exec(sp.textContent);if(m){sp.className='sc-cnt';sp.textContent=m[1];sp.title=m[1]+'품목';}});
    return r;};
  // 입출고 창: 길이 칸에 구분 꼬리표 + 처음 들어오는 길이는 구분 고르기
  function chooser(i,host,id){
    let box=el(id);const isNew=!!(chosenLen&&i.hasLength&&!(i.lengths||[]).some(l=>l.mm===chosenLen));
    if(!isNew){if(box)box.remove();return;}
    if(lkPick.len!==chosenLen)lkPick={len:chosenLen,kind:''};
    const html='<p>'+fmt(chosenLen)+'mm는 처음 들어오는 길이예요. 어떤 자재인가요?</p>'+lkSeg(lkPick.kind,'data-lk-new')+'<small>원장: 2400 원자재 · 컷팅: 생산지에서 잘라서 입고 · 잔재: 우리가 자르고 남은 것</small>';
    if(!box){box=document.createElement('div');box.id=id;box.className='lkc';host.after(box);}
    if(box.dataset.h!==html){box.innerHTML=html;box.dataset.h=html;
      box.querySelectorAll('[data-k]').forEach(b=>{b.onclick=()=>{lkPick={len:chosenLen,kind:b.dataset.k};box.dataset.h='';chooser(i,host,id);};});}
    box.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(b=>{b.disabled=frozen()||!!busy;});
  }
  const baseSheet=renderSheet;
  renderSheet=function(){const r=baseSheet.apply(this,arguments);
    try{const i=current();if(!sheetOpen||!i)return r;
      if(i.hasLength&&!editMode&&!cutMode){
        el('qs-lens').querySelectorAll('.qchip[data-len]').forEach(b=>{const k=lkOf(i,Number(b.dataset.len)),sm=b.querySelector('small');if(k&&sm&&!sm.querySelector('.lk-tag'))sm.insertAdjacentHTML('afterbegin',lkTag(k));});
        chooser(i,el('qs-lens'),'qs-lkind');
      }else{const b=el('qs-lkind');if(b)b.remove();}
    }catch(e){}
    return r;};
  if(typeof renderWork==='function'){const baseWork=renderWork;
    renderWork=function(){const r=baseWork.apply(this,arguments);
      try{const i=current(),host=el('len-chips');if(i&&host&&!sheetOpen)chooser(i,host,'wk-lkind');else{const b=el('wk-lkind');if(b)b.remove();}}catch(e){}
      return r;};}
  // 정보 수정(✎): 길이별 구분 바꾸기
  const baseToggle=toggleEdit;
  toggleEdit=function(){const r=baseToggle.apply(this,arguments);
    try{const i=current(),box=el('qe-lkinds');if(!box)return r;
      if(!editMode||!i||!i.hasLength){box.classList.add('hidden');box.innerHTML='';return r;}
      box.innerHTML='<div class="qs-label">길이 구분 (원장 · 컷팅 · 잔재)</div>'+visibleLengths(i).map(l=>'<div class="qe-lk-row"><span>'+fmt(l.mm)+'mm</span>'+lkSeg(l.kind||'','data-qe-lk="'+l.mm+'" data-was="'+esc(l.kind||'')+'"')+'</div>').join('');
      box.classList.remove('hidden');
      box.querySelectorAll('[data-qe-lk]').forEach(seg=>seg.querySelectorAll('[data-k]').forEach(b=>{b.onclick=()=>{seg.querySelectorAll('[data-k]').forEach(x=>{x.classList.toggle('on',x===b);x.setAttribute('aria-pressed',x===b);});};}));
    }catch(e){}
    return r;};
})();
/** 정보 수정에서 바뀐 길이구분만 {길이:구분}으로. 없으면 null */
function qeLkinds(i){const box=el('qe-lkinds');if(!box||box.classList.contains('hidden'))return null;const out={};let n=0;
  box.querySelectorAll('[data-qe-lk]').forEach(seg=>{const on=seg.querySelector('.on');const v=on?on.dataset.k:'';if(v&&v!==seg.dataset.was){out[seg.dataset.qeLk]=v;n++;}});return n?out:null;}
</script>
</body></html>
